SetSELECT.sel2: 'If it's just for a little while...'

File.name: 03-A0-A04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I've got to get out of the way...
Nn... I... I guess it can't be helped... since it's so crowded.

SetSELECT.sel1: 'If it's just for a little while...'

File.name: 03-A0-A05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Just a little... should be okay.

File.name: 03-A0-B01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Maybe I shouldn't have done that today...

File.name: 03-A0-B02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: That scent I smelled when we were pressed together, and that feeling in my chest...

File.name: 03-A0-C01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Do you still remember what happened when we first met Itou?
At the entrance ceremony, I... was mistaken for a junior high school student by a teacher, and the boys teased me about it.
It was Itou who helped me back then, wasn't it?
'You idiots, start acting your age and stop picking on girls!', he said.
And then you said, 'That Itou's a nice guy,'... we started to talk about him all the time...
And before long, you started to like him... and I promised I'd support you, didn't I?
But the truth is, even before you started to like him... as far back as the entrance ceremony...
Itou is there for you, Sekai.
As long as he's by your side, everything will be fine.

File.name: 03-A0-C02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Can you come to the school festival?

File.name: 03-A1-B01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I... don't think that I am.

File.name: 03-A1-B02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah, yes... um... it's not that I'm concerned about what happened yesterday.
Even if I am... it's not that I really hated it.
Then you won't mind if I come closer...
...And put my hand on you like this...
Makoto-kun! I'm sorry... I, um... I'm sorry...

File.name: 03-A1-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I am. I'm looking at the printout.
I'm sorry. They don't have enough people to carry the things from the club activities building,
so they need two or three people to help!
We should be carrying them along the side of the eastern club activities building, so... ah, it's this way.
Are you sure you aren't going?
I'm coloring this poster, aren't I?
Kioura Setsuna-san from year 1 class 3... please report to the staff room...

File.name: 03-A1-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If you have some business with me, then just tell me.
Itou... are you going out with Katsura-san?
I heard you the first time.

File.name: 03-A1-D01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: In other words, it happened because you two are fighting.
You could tell that Katsura-san came in looking for your help, but you ignored her.
She didn't come here looking for my help.
What I misunderstood was something else entirely.
I thought you and Sekai were going out.
The reason Sekai's been depressed is because you dumped her.
I didn't dump her... she dumped me.
She told me to go out with Kotonoha...

File.name: 03-A1-D02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Why not? This is about you, isn't it?
We... should be going out, but...
Kotonoha... I don't know how I feel about her anymore.
It might look like that from the outside... but I get the feeling it's a little different.
We're always so awkward around each other... I guess I'm just tired of it...

File.name: 03-A1-D03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: This is personal. Leave me alone.

File.name: 03-A1-D04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I love Sekai... and I thought she loved me.
Maybe she played along when I insisted that I loved her...
and then, when she saw how Kotonoha felt about me, she decided that Kotonoha would suit me better...

File.name: 03-A1-D05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I... I'm still not sure whether it's really love.
Because you've come to love Katsura-san?

File.name: 03-A1-D07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: And so in the end... she slapped me across the face.
Didn't you hear? It was right in front of everyone on the station platform, so someone from class might have seen it.
But that would explain everyone's reaction at lunchtime.
Don't worry about it. It won't be long before everyone forgets.

File.name: 03-A1-D08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Right now, if I were to call out to her, she'd recoil in shock.
Did you do something... to make her cringe?

File.name: 03-A1-D09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sekai was the one who introduced Kotonoha to me.
At first, she found out that I was interested in Kotonoha... and then she offered to introduce her to me.
Sekai and Katsura-san have nothing in common.
They didn't, but she got close to her for my sake...
She really likes poking her nose into other people's business.
'Leave it to me,' she said... I never even asked for her help...
But as I watched her do all she could to help me... I fell in love with her... and yet..

File.name: 03-A1-D10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...Are you going to keep doing that until I talk?
You just want me to speak, right?

File.name: 03-A1-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I tried going out with Kotonoha just like Sekai told me to, but... it's just so awkward, and nothing's going well...
I don't even know who I love anyone...
I... I don't know what I should do... anymore...
I don't even... trust my own feelings anymore...
For telling you these strange things... even though this has nothing to do with you...
You'll feel better just by telling someone about it.

File.name: 03-A1-E01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: B-but any normal guy is like that, right?!
...So, you ended up being hated by Katsura-san, and then you started going out with Sekai?
It's the other way around. Sekai dumped me and told me to go out with Kotonoha... and so I tried to do just that.

File.name: 03-A1-E02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well... I did hold her hand... and... touch her chest...
Any guy would have wanted to do the same!

File.name: 03-A1-E03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I didn't do anything like what you're imagining!
What do you think I was imagining?
So, Katsura-san became shocked and resentful after you assaulted her, so you started going out with Sekai?
Did you just remember about assaulting her?
I only really started going out with Kotonoha after Sekai dumped me.
Back when Sekai first introduced Kotonoha to me, and we were in the grey area of just starting to go out,
I found that I really loved Sekai instead and confessed to her...
When I told Sekai that I loved her, she said that she loved me too,
but when she saw that Kotonoha really loved me, Sekai told me to go out with her...
Yeah... just thinking about it makes me confused too.

File.name: 03-A1-E05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haha... I really lost it there for a second.
It's not like that... after all, it's all my own fault.

File.name: 03-A1-E06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You're a strange one, you know. I'm telling you all these things before I even think about why.
If only I'd known about you earlier, we could have gotten to know each other better...
I mean, you're a really good listener. Man, what a shame!
But you'll hear me out from now on, won't you?
What? This won't be the last time we do this, right? After all, I want to hear about you too.
Now then, I've finished coloring the poster, so... let's go home.

File.name: 03-A1-E07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Okay! Two sets of cake with black tea!
Next are this one and this one!
Let's see... three coffees, a cream pastry, two apple pies...
You sure took your time! Aren't you a member of the implementation committee?!
I guess there's no helping it, then.
More importantly, add one sandwich and coffee set!
Let's see... next comes two apple pie and black tea sets, a cinnamon roll and coffee...
Makoto! Time to switch over! Take a break for 20 minutes and grab something to eat!
We've got no choice! They say Ishimaru and Ohka are away too!
Gwah... that's the whole kitchen staff gone!
There're quite a few floor staff absent, too.
Okubo and Takeuchi. And Saionji, too...
Sekai too, huh... that's quite a few people.
Some are probably truly sick, but I'll bet a few of them just can't be bothered coming to the school festival.
Seems like Ishimaru and Okubo are out at Sakakino-cho on a date right now.
You can kill them tomorrow. For now, get some rest.
Yeah. Just leave the rest to me!
You heard him. I'm going to get some food and take a break.
Setsuna's taking a break now too. Why don't you two go together?
Itou says he's going for a break now too.

File.name: 03-A1-E08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: In the end, it was just us in the kitchen the whole time, with no relief.
Yeah, because Torii, Hasegawa, Ishimaru and Ohka all skipped school... our whole relief team...
I'm on the implementation committee, so I couldn't skip school.
You've got no such obligation, and yet you came to help me anyway.
You're just a temporary member anyway, right? That's what friends are for.
Still, even if you are just a temporary member, you really did your job, didn't you?
After all, the reason you're so worn out is because we had so many customers.
Now, then... time to go home, I guess.
Huh? Wasn't there going to be a bonfire?
Man, who gives a damn about...
Everyone's going to the bonfire now... do you want to go together?
Haah... now that I'm alone, I feel exhausted.
After all, I've been working all day...
And I thought you looked tough, too... come on, don't cry, it's just a little teasing.
Hey, come on... um... Kioura, was it?
Listen, if they come to mess with you again, call me over and I'll do something about it.
Yeah. Just leave it to me.
I know those guys, and they're not the type who don't listen to rea...
I don't know who you are, but...
I won't be dependent on anyone.
I see. Well, I guess it's good that you're strong like that.
Yeah. If you use that strength to become the class president and start going around the class taking care of business,
no one would bother you, right?
Yep. I think you'd make a great class president.
Great, then I'll put in a vote for you. Go on, take the job.
Well, now that you've stopped crying, I guess I'll be going.
Oh, sure, sure, that's right. Kioura the strong doesn't cry.
Come on, the ceremony's on. Let's go.
That's the sort of person Kioura was.
Yeah... sorry, were you waiting for me?
I was the one who asked you to wait.
I asked Hikari to pass on the message.
Ahh... my head's starting to clear now.
I fell asleep while I was waiting, didn't I?
It's totally dark... has the bonfire started yet?
Just now, right before I woke up, I had a dream... about you.
Maybe it was because we talked about the past during the day...
but it was about you and me during the school entrance ceremony.
You haven't changed a bit since then, have you?
Even though it's only been a few months since the entrance ceremony...
Ever since then... I've loved you.
Just once, that's all I ask... it'll be a secret between just the two of us.
Sorry, I didn't hear you. What did you say?
...I want you to call me Setsuna.
I don't think it's that big...

File.name: 03-A1-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Even though... the school festival is tomorrow...
Even though... we've got to make up...
At this rate... if Makoto-kun stays angry...
We won't be able to go around the festival together... and dance at the bonfire...
We are now connecting you to our voicemail service center...

File.name: 03-A1-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Are you going to take today off too?
If you are... then you won't mind if I do what I like just for today, will you?
Because this will probably be my last chance.
I'd planned on giving up... I'm sorry.

File.name: 03-A1-I00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Let's see... why don't we buy something to eat?
In that case... want to come with me for a while?
Ah...! Hey, g-get out of the way. Kioura?!

File.name: 03-A1-J00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Pretty awesome, right? It's not open to the normal students, you know.
You borrowed the key from Sekai as a member of the astronomy club, didn't you?
Ah... that's right, you knew about this.
I've eaten here before. Just once or twice in first semester, with Sekai and Nanami and the others.
It's been a while... but the view is nice.
Listen... this is kind of hard for me to say, but...
About what happened yesterday... it's a secret from everyone else, okay?
Knowing you, I don't think you'd tell anyone... but just in case.
I'd like to just stay here like this... and maybe take a midday nap.
Do you remember what happened at the entrance ceremony?
Oh... the entrance ceremony, huh. I think...
Yeah, that's right. Tohyama and Matsuhira were picking on you because of your height.
Uh-huh. And then, you saved me.
Tohyama and Hiramatsu are old friends from my class in primary school.
I just didn't want to see them do something stupid like picking on a girl.
Even so... it made me happy.
Really? Then consider your gratitude accepted.
I've always thought you were kind of strange,
but I certainly wasn't expecting to be thanked by you for something as far back as the entrance ceremony.
Now that you've brought up the entrance ceremony, I'm half-expecting you to mention the graduation ceremony next... haha...
Fwah... now that I've eaten, I feel all sleepy. I couldn't get to sleep last night, so I haven't had much rest.

File.name: 03-A1-Z02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'll never forget this moment. I'll treasure it forever.
But you need to forget about it.
About me, and how I loved you. Everything.
H-hey! What are you talking about?! To me, you're-
And take good care of Sekai.
You and her make a good couple. I've always thought so.
That's why I held back my feelings for you.
Sekai's been waiting for you. She never wanted to give you up to Katsura-san, but she held it all in...
and when she couldn't hold it in anymore, she cried.
But she still loves you, and she's still waiting for you to come for her.
Promise me that you'll take good care of her.
If you do... I'll feel better when I leave.
W-why all the way over there?
My mother is going over there for work. We're a single-parent family, just like Sekai's. I can't just stay here on my own.
I won't be able to protect Sekai anymore... so please, protect her in my place.
But... this is all so sudden...
I've only just started to understand you... only just started to fall in-
In that case, shall we go home?
Yeah... but before we do, can I ask for one more thing?
I'll keep it deep within my heart and try not to think about it...
...Give me one more thing to remember.

File.name: 03-AK-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Okay! Two sets of cake with black tea!
Next are this one and this one!
Let's see... three coffees, a cream pastry, two apple pies...
Damn it, I'm way too busy...
Thank God... so it's time to change over?
Yeah. Just leave the rest to me!
Oh, I went to the play at the gym... and the film society's self-produced movie.
What's with that look of pity?
Well... it'll be the same for me, I guess.
Sheesh... don't scare me like that.
Haha... well, I'm off to wander around.

File.name: 03-AK-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Maybe I should have gone around with Kotonoha instead...
Nothing much. My shift for class just ended, so I'm deciding what to do now.
Then go on and tell him.
What is it? Have you got a problem with me or something?
I don't remember doing anything to upset the girls from class 4. We've never really had much contact.
I'm telling you, that's not it.
Actually! It just so happens that I'm free now, too!
I'll pass. Going around with girls would only tire me out.
Ah! We've got some stuff to take care of now, so we won't be going with you.
It's our shift back at our class display. Right, Minami?
So, everyone from class 4 is helping with the class display.
I heard your class was scattered all over the place, and everyone was just doing what they wanted...
Really? So it's just you who's free, then?
I guess you could say that.
Let's take a walk around and have some fun, then, just like old times.

File.name: 03-AK-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haah... we sure went around to a lot of places.
Where should we go next? There's not much time left...
The roof isn't usually open, so it feels like we've come to a very special place, doesn't it?
I wonder how long it's been since we've been together like this?
Not since junior high, right? We sure raised hell back then, together with all the other guys.
But now we're in different classes, and you're in a club. There's not much left that connects us, is there?
Uh-huh. Even if we're in different classes... there's still something between us.
Well, if you say so. Got enough time left to make one more round? Shall we go somewhere else?
Ah, you don't have to force yourself to go if you're tired. I'm pretty tired, too.
Want to head straight back to class, then?
U-um, listen, there's this place where we can take a little rest.
There's a break room at the back of the haunted house our class is putting on.
Wait, don't you need to help with the haunted house?
Come to think of it, if you were with the girls in the morning and with me in the afternoon,
you haven't been helping at all, right?
Our class rep will just do it all for us.
You know, that girl who's been sitting at the reception the whole time.
She's slow, so we just dumped the role of being class rep onto her.
Everyone wanted to go out and have fun, so they pushed the job of watching the reception onto her and left.
'Everyone'...? The whole class was in on it...?
Yep. That's why you don't need to worry!

File.name: 03-AK-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Makoto-kun... what are you doing here?
Weren't you taking a walk around with Katou-san...?
Did you know...? They say that to go around the school festival together... means that you're going out.
Katou and I aren't like that.
But everyone thinks that you are. That you and Katou-san suit each other...
Is that what you think, too?
I... wanted to take a walk around with you... too.
I... want to be with you...
There's a tradition at this school...
when it comes time for the school festival, there's a secret sign a girl uses to invite the boy she likes.
It can't be a tradition if it's secret, right?
It's a secret, but all the girls know it.
You extend your hand like this... to the boy you like...
And if the boy is willing to go with that girl... he takes her hand.
And then...! In the back, the two of them are alone, and they...!
I...! If it's with you... no...! Because... I want us to... be a real couple... I...!
I-I'm sorry... I know it's sudden...
It's all right. You don't have to force yourself to do this.
I want to give you what you want...
Um... you mean touching my breasts...?
That's not it. You hold it between your breasts and stroke it.
Ah, you don't have to if it's too much. I just thought it'd be easier than sex...
O-oh, yeah. Take it out from my pants.
Nnn... put it between your breasts.
Make it wet with your saliva, and then slowly stroke it...
Then pull back your jaw... yes, now hold that position and lick it with your tongue.
Haauh...! I... I'm going... to come...!
Sorry for spraying it onto your face...
It's all right. I've already wiped it off.
More importantly... it seems like it's over, doesn't it?
The bonfire. And I wanted to enter the folk dance, too.
It's okay. I was able to experience something even more wonderful.
It felt good for you, didn't it?
It was good for me, too... it was a little embarrassing, but...
when I thought about how I was doing it for you, my body felt a little hotter... and I felt so indecent.
That's why I prefer this to the folk dance.
Now... will you forgive me for what happened yesterday?
I... want to make up with you.
I know we've ended up doing things in the wrong order... but I want to kiss you.

File.name: 03-AS-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hey, hey! Did you just have some trouble with some boys?!
Really? Yamagata-san told me because she was worried. She said you were surrounded by these big jocks or something,
so I came running right over to help you!
Oh. Well, that's our Setsuna. Not even the big guys scare you, do they? I could never have handled that.
That's not it... someone helped me.
It seems he's a boy from our class.
I see... so there are nice guys out there after all. What's his name?
Hmm, 'Itou', huh. Eheheh... okay, I'll go and do a little checking up on him, then.

File.name: 03-AS-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ooh... you didn't have to, you know.
There's nothing wrong with it, either.
Hey, you know, it seems that Yamagata-san is from the same junior high as Itou.
Ah, but she transferred in during third year,
and they were only together for a year, so she said she doesn't know him well. But hey, listen...
This 'Itou' seems like a pretty nice guy. Eheheh...
But just jumping in to save a girl you don't know isn't really something you just do, is it? Maybe...
Ahaha... 'like' might be a little too much, but he has feelings for you, right?
Uh-huh. After all... he hasn't said a word to me since.
Really? Still, I don't think he dislikes you.
Ahaha... if I hear any more info on Itou Makoto, I'll be sure to tell you, too.

File.name: 03-AS-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You did it! It was a close contest for the girls... my heart was pounding.
It's not something to be THAT happy about.
Ehh? But weren't you saying how you wanted to be the class rep?
You were. You said you wanted to be the class rep.
I didn't say I WANTED to do it, but someone told me it suited me...
I voted for you, just like I promised. Give it your best, okay?
Uwah... it was Itou, wasn't it?
What's this about a promise? Did you two suddenly start becoming close without me noticing?!
No. He just said he'd vote for me.
Oh. But that sure was a shock, wasn't it? To have him come up and talk to you, I mean.
I was panicking because I thought he'd found out about this morning.
Come on, you know what I mean. That charm you do by taking a photo with your phone.
The one where your love will come true if you hide it for three weeks?
Yep! I just happened to spot him this morning, so I took a photo. It's right under the cherry blossoms... neat, huh?!
I thought you weren't supposed to show anyone...?
Uh-uh. I thought I'd share it with you. Here, I'll send it to you.

File.name: 03-AS-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ehh?! Even though we're still barely into second semester?!
He said he's changing them because everyone's too noisy in their current spots.
Mmmn. But the only ones who are noisy are Sawanaga and a few of the other boys.
Ahh... but the seat swap itself could be nice!
Uh-huh. We might get to meet someone new or something, right?
Ooh! That's not what I mean!
So, now there's a boy you like.
W... well, there IS someone I'm kind of interested in, but that's all there is to it.
It's not like I like him or hate him...
well, actually, I've been interested in him for a long time now, but still...
So, you've finally reached that age where you start becoming interested in boys... pfft!
Ooh! Don't tease me about it!
Okay, okay. So, who is it?
I - told - you, it's not like that.
Haah... well, whatever. I've got the straws for the seat change, so help me hand them out.
No good at all. It's the first seat in the window aisle. This sucks...
Really? I think the view would be pretty good.
Sure, the view's nice, but... ah, where did you end up?
Ehh?! What's this?! Don't leave me hanging and tell me!
The last seat... in the window aisle.
Aw, man... this isn't my day. I'm next to Tanaka. Tanaka!
You might not mind since you're a student rep like him,
but he's in the judo club, isn't he? I'm no good with big guys at all...
It's just a coincidence, and knowing me, I don't think we'll be getting to know each other the way you're thinking,
The boy you like... it's Itou...
At first, I went around asking about him since I thought he would suit you. After all, he was nice to you...
but... gradually, I started becoming interested in him...
You're a class rep, so you have plenty of opportunities to talk to him, right?
Just watching him talk with you, I started to think, 'Wow, he's kind of cool,'...
and then it just wouldn't stop from there...
I might never get the chance to sit next to him again. I... want to be next to him...
You'll support me, won't you? You said he was a nice guy too, right?

File.name: 03-B0-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: We sure went around to a lot of places.
The fortune teller, the film research club, the storytelling research club...
And the brass band performance in the gym, too.
Oh, that's right. Our drama club's really made a big effort, too.
It was very professional, wasn't it?
Yeah. Then there was that haunted house.
The one the third-years did. The mood was incredible, and it was really scary, wasn't it?
Ah... I just couldn't help comparing it to the one our class is doing.
Your class...? Come to think of it, we haven't been there, have we? Shall we go now?
No! If I go now, I'll have to sit at the counter again...
Haha... well, we can't have you getting stuck being the receptionist.
Still, class 4's haunted house looks pretty good from the outside.
Not at all. It's terrible on the inside...
There's even a bed in there...
I'm glad we were able to see the festival together today.
I really wanted to walk around the festival with you... so it makes me really happy.
To be able to see the festival together... is something all girls dream of.
There's a tradition here at our school. A legend that goes like this...
If a couple goes around the festival together and dances together at the bonfire afterward,
I've been so busy with the preparations lately that I haven't been able to see you much...
I was a little worried that you'd made plans to see the festival with someone else.
I know. I know that you'd never... turn your attention towards another girl.
But I do get anxious... because I love you...
The preparations for the bonfire have now been completed... those attending, please gather on the grounds... futhermore...
...Looks like it's almost time for the bonfire.

File.name: 03-B0-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The preparations for the bonfire have now been completed... those attending, please gather on the grounds... furthermore...
Come on, let's go to the bonfire!
Ehh?! Let's go! You might as well!
Hmmn... well, I guess it can't be helped, then.
Sekai... have you got a moment?
Setsuna... sorry, can it wait until later?

File.name: 03-B1-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haah... we sure went around to a lot of places.
Where should we go next? There's not much time left...
The roof isn't usually open, so it feels like we've come to a very special place, doesn't it?
I wonder how long it's been since we've been together like this?
Not since junior high, right? We sure raised hell back then, together with all the other guys.
But now we're in different classes, and you're in a club. There's not much left that connects us, is there?
Uh-huh. Even if we're in different classes... there's still something between us.
Well, if you say so. Got enough time left to make one more round? Shall we go somewhere else?
Ah, you don't have to force yourself to go if you're tired. I'm pretty tired, too.
Want to head straight back to class, then?
U-um, listen, there's this place where we can take a little rest.
There's a break room at the back of the haunted house our class is putting on.
Wait, don't you need to help with the haunted house?
Come to think of it, if you were with the girls in the morning and with me in the afternoon,
you haven't been helping at all, right?

Ehh? You have a little sister?! Hey! Is she about as old as I am?
She's much smaller than you, Kokoro-chan.
Hey, onee-chan! He called me 'Kokoro-chan'! Uwaah! Uwaah!
This is so exciting! Onee-chan's boyfriend is such a nice guy!

File.name: 03-KA-A07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, you can call me stingy, but listen...
your sister and I want to talk by ourselves right now, so have some consideration for us.
Well, you heard her. Back downstairs with you...
You're going to do something perverted.
I said wait! We're not going to do anything perverted!
You are. You were about to kiss just then, too.
I opened the door quietly and watched through the crack, you know.
L-listen, I suddenly really feel like playing with you, Kokoro-chan. Right, Kotonoha?
Just a little while can't hurt, right?
You heard her. Shall we play together, Kokoro-chan?
So long as you understand. Nice to be playing with you, onii-chan.
After all, you really might become my brother-in-law one day. Eheheh...

File.name: 03-KA-A08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ahh! He can't decide! Onee-chan, this guy is indecisive.
Ahh! Now I'm annoyed. I knew it. He's naturally indecisive.
Must be tough having such an indecisive boyfriend, onee-chan.
We're okay now. You can go back downstairs.
No way! If I go back, I won't get my allowance.
...Yeah. Dad said to stick with you and make sure nothing funny happens.
If I do a good job of watching you, he'll give me an allowance.
Well, that's okay. Let's all play together, then.
It's only natural for your dad to worry, right?
He doesn't know what sort of guy I am,
and when he heard the two of us would be spending time alone, he probably couldn't help himself.
I don't want your family to hate me... and besides...
It looks like it'll be fun to hear from Kokoro-chan about her sister. Tell me all about her, Kokoro-chan.
Okay! Well, when onee-chan was in primary school, there was this time at the pool...

File.name: 03-KA-A09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: He wasn't the dangerous person you were worried about, Dad.
'Dangerous person'... just what were you thinking, Dad?
Oh, going home already? How about dinner?
Ah, no, I've got to be getting back soon.
Really? Well, see you later. Next time, come and eat with us, okay?
I'll walk him to the station, Mom.

File.name: 03-KA-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Just the opposite. I love roasted green tea.
Mom told me to go with green tea today, but we usually have black tea,
so I was a worried whether you'd like it or not.
Ah, would you like some more?
Are you looking forward to it?
Looking forward to it...? Well, I guess so, but... I feel kind of nervous, you know?
It's just your normal, average house.
Really? We live in an apartment, so I look up to houses.
Well, our family is just Mom and me, so we're fine even with a cramped apartment.
You live alone with your mother?
Oh? Didn't I tell you? We're a single-parent family.
Haha... it's no big deal. There are plenty of them out there, you know.
Besides, my parents may be divorced, but my little sister comes to see us every month.
And I could go and see Dad if I wanted to, too. Not that I would, though.
I see... ah, you have a little sister, don't you?
Her name's 'Itaru'. She's really attached to me, too.
She comes over to play even in the months when Mom can't get off work to be there.
It's always difficult when she leaves, because she always cries and says she doesn't want to leave me.
What about you, Kotonoha? Do you have any siblings?
Just my little sister. Her name's 'Kokoro'.
'Kotonoha' and 'Kokoro', huh... I wonder if those names convey how your parents feel about you.
So, you have a sister... is she cute?
She's cheeky, and she's always teasing me.
Together with my mother... about you...
After all, it's the first time I've ever gone out with a boy...
and when I asked Mom for advice, she told Kokoro too, so the two of them...
Did she say anything funny to you yesterday?
No... though she did ask me every question in the book.
When I left the house this morning, she had this knowing smile and said, 'This'll be perfect for today's drink!'
Yes. I thought it was strange, but she heard it from you on the phone yesterday, didn't she?
Come to think of it, I did mention that I liked roasted green tea.
Well, it was for the best anyway. I'm glad she did it.
I have a student rep meeting today, so we can't go home together... but I'll be waiting for you tomorrow.
It's been a week since Sekai disappeared.
I've been going out with Kotonoha...
but all we've done is see that one movie last week, eat lunch together every day and call each other before we sleep.
I touch her for just a second... and look what happens.

File.name: 03-KA-B01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If I'd known it'd be like this, then Sekai would have been...

File.name: 03-KA-B02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: We'll be in her room, all alone... surely even she doesn't think that nothing's going to happen.
In that case... maybe we can make a little progress.
...I think I'll be looking forward to it.

File.name: 03-KA-B03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Guess there's no point in being depressed.

File.name: 03-KA-B04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I just had quite a surprise.
I didn't know that you'd been selected for the implementation committee.
Oh, yeah, that. I was suddenly told just last week.
It was only decided last week?

File.name: 03-KA-B05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ooh... that was one big surprise.
...But I like this kind of surprise.
Ufufu... now, for a little while until the school festival, we'll be together after school too.

File.name: 03-KA-B06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ooh... did you forget when you came over on the weekend, too?

File.name: 03-KA-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: After what happened... Sekai stopped coming to school.
More than once, I thought about calling her... but I had no idea what to say...
About the preparations for the school festival again...
We're doing a refreshment booth, right? With black tea and cake and stuff.
Tanaka from the implementation committee is...
Don't just kill him off like that!
Kuroda. Has something happened to Tanaka?
Mmn... he just called. It seems he's broken a bone.
Ehh?! But the judo club's counting on him! He's built like a heavy tank!
Well, he went along with the judo club on their retreat.
Yeah. He's a first-year, but he's already a regular. Pretty incredible, huh?
And so, he broke his right foot while he was in a training match.
It's pretty serious. They say he'll be hospitalized for two weeks.
That's exactly when the school festival is on, right?
So when they had to hold a meeting to decide his replacement, the boys all refused and there was a big fuss.

File.name: 03-KA-C01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Who's our female committee member again?
All student reps are implementation committee members.
You really have no interest in our class at all, do you? Don't you feel stupid just watching from the sidelines?
Oh, I know. You do it: you be Tanaka's replacement.
It'll only be until he gets out of the hospital. That much should be okay, right?
If you don't score some points with Setsuna, you'll make a bad impression on Sekai.
But come to think of it, Kotonoha's a committee member too... this means we could be together.
But only until Tanaka gets out of the hospital, okay?
Of course! Thanks. In that case, I'll allow you to talk to Sekai if it's just for a little bit.
Setsuna! Itou says he'll do it!
Like I need your permission to talk to her...

File.name: 03-KA-C02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hey, hey. What's going on here? You aren't the sort of guy who takes on bothersome jobs like this.
I can't exactly tell him that I want to take every chance I can get to be with Kotonoha.
Forget about it. You'll get no benefit out of doing something li... gwah!
Are you serious about doing this?
Uh... well, it's just until Tanaka gets out of the hospital, right? I can do that much.
You'd better! Setsuna! Itou says he'll do it!

File.name: 03-KA-C03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I know: you do it, mister committee member.
You look like you've got time on your hands, right?
You've got nothing to do, and that's why you keep trying to move in on Sekai! Listen, you're going to do this!
Uh... well, it'll only be until Tanaka gets out of the hospital, okay?
Okay. Setsuna! Itou says he'll be the replacement!
Well, since I'm a committee member, I'll be able to see Kotonoha too... so I guess it's all right.

File.name: 03-KA-C04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...So, the long table request forms go to the student council, and the things to be carried out go to storage.
Just take the printout with you, and you'll be fine.
Everyone else has already finished eating.

File.name: 03-KA-C05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Okay, guess I'd better start eating too...

File.name: 03-KA-C07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm not calling anyone. It's an e-mail.
W-well, guess I'd better start eating too...

File.name: 03-KA-C08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Really? You mean you ate extra slowly today?
I sent her an e-mail a little while ago, but it seems she can't come.
That e-mail just then... that was to Sekai?
Hey, there's no need for you to apologize.
Ah... looks like it's the end of lunchtime.
Well, see you later. Thanks for the explanation.

File.name: 03-KA-C09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Right now? It's lunchtime, you know?
We can't have it during class, and I have a student rep meeting afterwards.

File.name: 03-KA-C10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, I guess that's the best we can do.
Well, when you put it like that, I can't help but wait too.

File.name: 03-KA-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry. My family sure caused a fuss, didn't they?
Oh, not at all. Like I said before, I'm from a single-parent family, so I like that kind of atmosphere.
It's so lively, and I can feel... you know, the warmth of your family.
It makes me think, 'So this is the kind of warmth Kotonoha spends her life enveloped in.'
My parents are always busy with work,
so we try to have as much fun as we can when we're all together... at least, that's what Dad says.
I see. Your dad sure is incredible.

File.name: 03-KA-D01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Just kidding. It's not as if we ever do that anyway.
Ah, sorry. I didn't mean to blame you...
I want to try and avoid doing anything you wouldn't like.
It's just that... sometimes, I can't help but want to. I'm a guy, after all...
I... kind of thought it was kind of a shame too.
Just when I'd gathered my determination, Kokoro came in.
She's not usually like that. She was really excited because you were coming over...
I guess I should be honored.
Next time, I'll make sure to tell her not to come into my room.
...Don't you want to come over again?
No, that's not what I mean...
...But does that mean next time, we can kiss?

File.name: 03-KA-D02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry... next time, I'll tell her not to come into my room. Next time, we'll be alone, and...
You mean next time, we can kiss?

File.name: 03-KA-D03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: We couldn't really talk... since Kokoro was there.
Like I said, there's no need to feel bad about that.
I'm really sorry... next time you come over, she definitely won't be able to get in.
You don't have to go th... ah.
You'll invite me over again, then?
I'd... be very happy if you'd come.
But in that case, it really will be just the two of us, you know?
Yes, and without Kokoro, we'll be able to talk properly.
What I mean is... does that mean we can kiss?

File.name: 03-KA-D04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sorry. It was a joke. I won't say anymore.

File.name: 03-KA-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'll send you an e-mail when I get home.
Would you mind leaning down for a second?

File.name: 03-KA-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: A kiss on the cheek, huh...

File.name: 03-KA-F01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haah... looks like we've got a rough road ahead of us.

File.name: 03-KA-F03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Aw, never mind. I guess there's no need to send it today.

File.name: 03-KA-F04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...That ought to do it. It's what I want, after all.
I wonder how long it'll be before she isn't afraid of me holding her...

File.name: 03-KA-F05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...She'll probably be terrified if I write anything specific, so I'd better end it on a soft note.
Being right in front of those incredible breasts, and yet not being able to touch them... it's like torture.
Just thinking about it makes me kind of...
C-crap. I'd better get to sleep...

File.name: 03-KA-F06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Aw, forget it. 'I want us to go further' is good enough.
We sure are taking a long time to get anywhere... haah...

File.name: 03-KA-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Looks like Sekai's away today too...
Guess I'll catch some more sleep... mnyah...
Uwah! What do you want, Kuroda?
Weren't you listening during homeroom this morning?!
They said there's a lunchtime meeting of the implementation committee members at the big meeting room, right?
Oh yeah, I guess they did. But that's got nothing to do with me, right? Just let me sleep... mnyah...
Okay, okay! Sheesh! You're so loud!

File.name: 03-KA-G01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sorry, but I've made other plans. See you later.

File.name: 03-KA-G02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: To: Katsura Kotonoha\nSub: Sorry\nClass meeting on today. Don't think I can make lunch. Sorry.

File.name: 03-KA-G03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Stop spacing out and take a seat over there.
Take out the printouts. I'll check them.

File.name: 03-KA-G04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The person you made plans with.

File.name: 03-KA-G05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You can go, if it's to see Sekai.

File.name: 03-KA-G06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I think she's probably in that courtyard...

File.name: 03-KA-G07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I don't know. It's the truth.

File.name: 03-KA-G08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You don't have to tell me.
So long as you know yourself.

File.name: 03-KA-G09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Um... Taisuke and the others are probably at the cafeteria, so I was thinking of meeting up with them.
If you're looking for Sawanaga, he's in the staff room right now.
It's the third time he's been late this month, so he's been summoned there.
...Come to think of it, he did get called out by Yamamoto at homeroom.
Okay, I'll eat here too, then.
I could give you some of my bread.
I'd be glad to have some.

File.name: 03-KA-G10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Just what are Katsura-san and you...
I'm going to eat here today, too.
It's fine. Just stop talking and eat.

File.name: 03-KA-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: U-um... we're just about to have an implementation committee meeting.
Would you mind going on ahead and waiting for me?
Yes. I'll come up to the roof after the meeting is over.
We're just about to have an implementation committee meeting for the school festival.
I'm a member of the committee too.
Eh?! But isn't the member for class 3...
He's in the hospital with a broken bone, and I'm his replacement.

File.name: 03-KA-H01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: And if I became a member, we could stay together during the meetings, too, right?
It's only until the school festival, but it's nice to be working with you.
Yes, nice to be working with you too.

File.name: 03-KA-H02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah. Well, now that you know, nice to be working with you.
Yes, nice to be working with you too.

File.name: 03-KA-H04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Uwah! Kioura, haven't you gone inside yet?

File.name: 03-KA-H07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So, it's the kind of relationship you'd hesitate to talk about.

File.name: 03-KA-H08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, not really sleepy. More like... bored?
You weren't listening to the explanation, were you?
...Well, I'll just ask you if there's something I don't understand.
We're going to have to explain it to everyone in our class,
so the construction isn't going to get anywhere if you have to ask me.
Really? That's going to be a problem.
Want me to explain it now?

File.name: 03-KA-H09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I don't understand any of this implementation committee stuff, and I've still got another meeting.... sorry.
It's okay, I understand. See you later, then.
'Today,' you say... are you and Katsura-san doing something?
Ahh... don't you worry about that.
...Okay. I'll explain everything now, so let's go back to the classroom.

File.name: 03-KA-H10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sorry, I'll listen to you explain it later. Bye.

File.name: 03-KA-I00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Uhh... now, please take a look at the printout.
Uhh... now, please take a look at the printout. We'll begin with the general points of note on the construction. These rules are...

File.name: 03-KA-I01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Now, please divide yourselves up by year. The first-years will work on producing posters and sorting printouts.
Second years, please attend to moving the folding chairs and long tables.
Dull or not, we're still going to do it.
Shall we sort the printouts together?
Now use it to paint this poster.
H-hold on, I can't do both the posters and the printouts at the same time.
What are you getting all irritated for?

File.name: 03-KA-I02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sorry, Kioura. I'm going to sort the printouts.
Ah, but I'll come and help afterwards.
Let's see... 2, 3, 4... that's right, isn't it?
Good. Now for the next one.
Yeah. It's not as if we have to work by class. There's nothing wrong with this, right?

File.name: 03-KA-I03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sorry, Kotonoha. I'm going to work on the posters.
Come on, let's get to work.
Weren't you the one who told me to do it?
Come on, where and how do I paint?
Make it red all the way up to that edge.
Okay, next comes white... whoa, better wash my brush.

File.name: 03-KA-I04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hey! Can someone from first year help with the moving over here?

File.name: 03-KA-I05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Shall I call you 'Makoto' too, then?

File.name: 03-KA-I06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Using someone's first name is just what people who are close do.
Makoto. You're painting this part next.
W-wait, why are you calling me by my first name too?

File.name: 03-KA-I07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hey, don't just make up your own interpretation.
...Sekai and Sawanaga use my first name too, right?
In that case, I'll call you 'Makoto' too.

File.name: 03-KA-I08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Somehow... I get the feeling I'm starting to understand your personality.
You're a pretty decent person, aren't you?
And that particular side of you is kind of cute, too.
Did you only just realize that?
I've got to fire back every once in a while too, you know.

File.name: 03-KA-I09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's more like... I'm your pitiful slave who keeps being ordered around.

File.name: 03-KA-J00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Itou and I are about to have a meeting for our class.
Did you and Katsura-san have plans?
Come on, let's go back to the classroom. It'd be better to explain quickly before lunchtime ends.

File.name: 03-KA-J01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's not like I can just go and see Sekai.
Kotonoha's probably finished eating and gone back to class, too...
Haah... guess I'll grab something to eat by myself at the cafeteria.

File.name: 03-KA-J02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Phew... I end up helping the second years with the moving, and now just look at the time.

File.name: 03-KA-J03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haah... it's getting pretty late, isn't it?
Want to grab a bite to eat somewhere?
Sorry. I've got to take care of something.
Nothing to be sorry about. We haven't made plans yet.
Haha... I'm starting to get used to the way you talk. Well, see you later.

File.name: 03-KA-K00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Do you have anything to do with the class president from class 4?
It seems that girl and Itou are doing something together.
I told you, I don't know!

File.name: 03-KA-K01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Were you busy during lunch today?
I wrote you an e-mail, but you didn't come.
I was out for a little while...
Itou's been feeling lonely, you know.

File.name: 03-KA-L00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'll eat here today. Come on, take out your lunch. Let's eat.

File.name: 03-KA-L02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: In an absent-minded kind of way, I thought about it...

File.name: 03-KA-L04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I've begun to enjoy preparing for the school festival.
Kioura, who had always struck me as a quiet and awkward person, was surprisingly helpful,
and unmotivated though I was, she skillfully manipulated me into doing my proper job as a committee member.
But despite everything, the truth was, the work didn't really bother me.
It was beginning to become apparent to me... that I was starting to look forward to the festival.

File.name: 03-KA-L05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: No, it's probably best not to think at all.
Now's not the time to come to conclusions.

File.name: 03-KA-L06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...And feel her body in my hand...
My head was filled with such thoughts...

File.name: 03-KA-L07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Now that I think about it...

File.name: 03-KA-L08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The soft form of Kotonoha's body drifted into my mind.
Overwhelmed by depression, I no longer knew what I should do...
I began to feel that it would be dangerous right now for me to make my feelings clear.
Maybe it would be for the best if they stayed this way for a little longer...

File.name: 03-KA-L09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I haven't eaten lunch with her either yesterday or today.
It's only been two days, and yet, somehow...

File.name: 03-KA-L10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I've only missed the one lunch with her today, and yet, somehow...

File.name: 03-KA-M00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Was I always as cold-hearted as this...?
Even thinking about it casually was enough to make me feel depressed.

File.name: 03-KA-M01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Is this how it feels to be in love...?
But there's a prickling, tickling sensation at the bottom of my heart telling me that I want to see and talk to her.
Just thinking about meeting her at the committee meeting after class is enough to set my heart pounding.

File.name: 03-KA-M02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I don't really know how I feel about her.
Maybe it's because I've been spending time with a strange girl like Kioura.
She may seem brusque, but she's surprisingly helpful, and before I know it, I'm enjoying being on the committee.
And though I might pretend that I can't be bothered, she probably knows otherwise.

File.name: 03-KA-O00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It seems like it's rush hour.

File.name: 03-KA-P00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So, it seems I'm going after all.
Same as always. She might be feeling a little down, I guess.
My mom made a huge fuss about it.
Why not come live with us? It's cramped, but if it's just the two of us, it should be fine!
He'll support you from now on.
Knowing him, I'm sure he'll stay by your side.
That's why everything will be fine.
No... that's something he mustn't do.
I don't understand! I don't want this!
Are you fine with this?! I'm not... I won't stand for it!
We're going to be together forever...
Let's stay together... I don't want to be alone...

File.name: 03-KB-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I guess it's what you'd call a tradition... well, anyhow, they say there's something like that.
Hmmn. Will you be going around the festival with your boyfriend, then?
I don't have anyone to go with.
Nanami, do you and Katsura-san know each other?
We just went to the same junior high. What, do you know her?
She's the implementation committee member for class 4.
Hmm... so, will you be going around the festival with your boyfriend?

File.name: 03-KB-A02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm just going to the student council room to get some colored paper...
I... I'm going to the shed to get some chairs...
Yes. We're going to use them for the haunted house.
Yes, there are six more I have to bring.

File.name: 03-KB-A03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I guess I shouldn't be asking you that, should I?

File.name: 03-KB-A05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah, all things considered, I guess I shouldn't be helping.

File.name: 03-KB-A06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sorry. I guess I shouldn't be saying...

File.name: 03-KB-A07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I said we should distance ourselves, but we're right next door, so I guess it wouldn't be unusual to run into her.

File.name: 03-KB-A08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I just can't stop myself from thinking about her.

File.name: 03-KB-A09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Maybe Kotonoha and I... just don't suit each other.

File.name: 03-KB-A10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...Not sure how I feel about her.
Just... what is it that I want to do...?

File.name: 03-KB-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Minami, is it true the plans are done?
Yeah, it's a secret from the boys, you know.
Wow... these are the plans for the haunted house?
But... there's no you-know-what, is there?
Yeah, these are the ones we show to the boys. And THESE...
So, there are two of them!
Ah! The blackboard's here, so look at it like this...
If we make it any bigger than that, other people are going to see.
Besides, it doesn't have to be that wide. You both just have to lie down.
I've brought the veneer. Ah, is it done?
Wow, so that's how it is. It's pretty amazing, isn't it.
Isn't it just? Hey, you'll be inviting him too, won't you?
That guy who doesn't know how you feel about him?
U-um... I don't know. After all, he'd probably turn me down...
No way. There's no boy who'd turn down a confession from you.
...So, just who is this boy that you like?
C-come on. If we keep talking like this, we won't be ready in time for tomorrow.
Ah, that's right. The girls from basketball said they'll come by later and help.
If we don't start building Koizumi-san's areas soon, I don't think we'll finish in time...
Oh, shut up. We're just about to start.
Stop nagging us about every little thing. We're working at our own pace.
Sheesh... just when we were about to start, too. She's such a pain.
Besides, the boys are slacking off, too. She ought to go and warn them instead.
She wants to be popular with the boys, so she's only picking on us.
Think she'll be taking turns with different boys on festival day?
Hey, come to think of it...
Mmn... well, it's just a rumor...
Just the other day, my friend in class 2 said she saw her walking around Sakakino with a boy from class 3.
Fwah... they're definitely going out, then!
You think so? Maybe he's her client instead of her boyfriend.
So who was she walking around with?
Um... whatshisname from class 3... you know... um, 'Itou', I think? Kind of a plain name...
Itou? They have a guy with that name?
Yep. No mistake about it. Itou from class 3.
So in other words, Itou is Katsura's...?
Just because they're walking around together doesn't mean he's BUYING her! Maybe they just happened to run into each other.
Ehh? But a guy from class 3 wouldn't have had any contact with her before.
He's not paying her. I'm sure of it.
In that case, do you think they're going out?
No! It's just that she's loose and good at tricking boys... there's no way they're going out.
I've worked out who you were going to invite.
W... what are you talking about?!
Fufufu... you don't mind if I say it, do you? Do you?

File.name: 03-KB-B01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: They want the paper for the menu to be blue after all. Can you go and grab some for us?
Come on, Sekai. Stop staring at your darling and start sewing!
I-I'm not staring! And what do you mean by 'darling'?!
Oh! It's really coming together, isn't it?
Mmn... just the skirt for now.
Still, we already have the blouses, so you're almost done, right?
I think we could finish it by tomorrow somehow... probably.
Anyone who doesn't finish in time for tomorrow gets no free time.
And Nanami, if you go off to make out with your boyfriend instead of finishing your work for tomorrow, you're dead.
B-but I've got to help with the girls' basketball club too...
Don't be so soft. Girls' basketball is in the afternoon, so I know you can make it after finishing your morning shift.
And the same goes for you, Sekai. No making out with your darling if you don't finish in time.
I told you, he's not my 'darling'.
Sawanaga. The long tables are in the shed after all.
Eh?! I went just now, and there were none.
I bet you didn't look properly. They were in the back on the left.
If you found them, then you might as well have carried them back.
You can't make a girl carry something heavy like that. Come on, off you go.

File.name: 03-KB-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm really sorry. You're not hurt, are you?
Are you taking that chair back to your class?
Ah, my name is Katsura. I'm from class 4.
No, um... Saionji-san and Makoto-kun are... um... I mean...
They sure get along well, don't they?
We used to have a lot of fun together before second semester, but now that he's going out with Saionji...
Did you hear that from them?
I don't know what's keeping them, then...
you know, Kioura and the other girls were saying that they were going out, so I totally thought that they were.
Fufu... is that because they're always eating lunch together?
Well, they're eating together by themselves, right?
Well, Mako... Itou-kun already has a girlfriend.
Eh?! Seriously? And it's not Saionji?
I see... I had no idea.
They've... had a little fight, but... they're still going out.
Well, I guess you can't go out without a couple of fights, right?
Yeah, even if they did fight, all she has to do is ask him to spend the festival with her, and they'll have made up.
U-um, listen... I was just curious...
Well... you know how it's the school festival tomorrow?
Would you... like to come and take a walk around with me?
Ah... Sawanaga-san, you're in class 3, right?
Yes. Shall I ask her for you?
H-hold on a just a second.
Don't you want to go with her?
Well, it's not that... but Saionji and Makoto are...
Yes. If she agrees... would you like to accompany us?
I'll be inviting someone too... so that we can make up.
I see... so you've had a fight with your boyfriend too.
We just had a little misunderstanding... but it's really nothing.
Here we are. Thank you very much.
Well, please give it your best shot.

File.name: 03-KB-C03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What is it? I'm in a hurry right now, so put it off until later.

File.name: 03-KB-C04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Which one should I go to...?

File.name: 03-KB-C05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: How long's it been since we've done something with the guys? We used to hang out all the time in junior high, didn't we?
Yeah... we've really lost contact with them, haven't we?
Mmn... well, we're going to different schools now... I guess that's just how it is.
Oh, I know. The girls' basketball club is doing fortune telling. Why don't we go there?
Sorry, I've just remembered something I've got to do.

File.name: 03-KB-C06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: And after I went and announced, 'I'm going to go with Sekai today!' to Taisuke, too...
Actually, he'd probably be happy to hear it...
I thought you two were going together. She did invite you, didn't she?
The festival's almost over, right? The final event is a folk dance on the grounds.
I think that's where Sekai will go.
If she's not going, then I'll drag her there.
I... I see... okay, I'm counting on you.

File.name: 03-KB-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Why do you think I picked up the phone, you idiot?
Oh, I was just wondering if you were awake.
What are you going on about?

File.name: 03-KB-D01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah, no. A-actually, it's... um... well, I wanted your advice...
You dumbass! Give me a break!
I'm not into homosexuality! Try someone else!
Are you and Saionji... wait, homosexuality?!
I only think of you as a friend, okay? Okay?! Please, understand!
Y-you're the dumbass! Who the hell would confess to you?!
Then who is it? I won't complain as long as you don't do it within my sight, so just take it outside of class...
You don't get turned on by exposed pecs or tight biceps?
Haah... that's true. After all, you've got a sister complex, so there's no way you'd be interested in anyone else.
You sure aren't holding back, are you?
Yeah. There's this girl I'm kind of interested in.

File.name: 03-KB-D02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Actually, there's this girl who I've been interested in for a while now.

File.name: 03-KB-D03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...There's something I want to get your advice on... I mean, something I want to ask you.
...The truth is, there's this girl who... I've been interested in for a while now.

File.name: 03-KB-D04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So, I mean, I want to invite her to the school festival...
A girl from outside the school?
Who is it? Go on, tell me.
I heard that you and her were going out, so... I didn't think I could invite her.
But it seems you're not actually going out with her. Instead, I hear there's another girl you're seeing...

File.name: 03-KB-D05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: From the girls in our class?
Sheesh... those girls are always making up stuff without thinking...

File.name: 03-KB-D07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's okay. If you don't want to say who you're going out with, I won't force you to tell me.

File.name: 03-KB-D08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I've already broken up with her.
It just wasn't working out between us.
'Wasn't working out'...? You've only had a little fight, right?
It's more a difference in how we feel than a fi... wait, how did you know that?!
How does that matter?! Listen, fights are what happen when two people are too close, right?
You can't say, 'Okay, let's break up,' just because you've had a couple of fights and felt awkward about them!
If you're a real man, then you should try standing in her shoes.
Listen up! You're going to make up with her!
I... I see... I'll think about it.
Okay, I'll make up with her.
Good. So, getting back to the topic...
Yeah, what were we talking about?
About how I'm going to invite Saionji to the school festival.
Well, I'm going to do my best, so you ought to give it your best too making up with your girlfriend.
Haah... I feel so relieved now that I've told you everything. Well, see you tomorrow.

File.name: 03-KB-D09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I-I see. Yeah... so, you two are going out after all...
That's how I feel about her... but she doesn't feel the same way.
So that's why you started going out with another girl?

File.name: 03-KB-D10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah! No! Listen, it's not that I'm trying to find out who she is.
There's such a thing as a relationship you'd want to keep secret, right? I totally understand.
My sister's the same. She's going out with a guy who has another girlfriend, and of course it's a secret from everyone.
But she looks so happy... I don't really understand it, but what I do know is that all I can do is watch.
Whatever your circumstances are, you don't have to tell me about them.
I just didn't want to invite Saionji without checking if it was okay with you.
But now that I know you aren't going out with her, I think I'll be able to work up the courage to ask her out tomorrow.
Sorry about calling you for something weird like this.
Just watch me tomorrow... but don't laugh even if she says no, okay?

File.name: 03-KB-E01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It doesn't matter who your girlfriend is. I just didn't want to invite Saionji without checking if it was okay with you.
But now that I know you aren't going out with her,
I think I'll be able to work up the courage to ask her out tomorrow.
Sorry about calling you for something weird like this.
I'm going to give it my best shot tomorrow. Just watch me.

File.name: 03-KB-E03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah, that's right. Sekai's popular with the boys, too. It was always strange for us to be together.
It's only natural that Taisuke would want to invite her...
What the hell... am I doing...?

File.name: 03-KB-E04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What can I do? Sekai was the one who told me to go out with her. Even after I told Sekai I loved her... that's why...

File.name: 03-KB-E05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Because Sekai... told me to go out with her...
Well, I'm still going to try inviting her, even if I've got no chance.
If even someone as close to her as you got turned down, then I'll probably get rejected too, but... I love her.
Let's both be buddies in rejection. Well, good night!

File.name: 03-KB-E06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You went out with another girl just because Saionji turned you down...

File.name: 03-KB-E07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eh?! W-what did you just say...?!
Tomorrow, Sekai is going with me!

File.name: 03-KB-E08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah. Knowing you, I'm sure it'll be fine.
Haha... it's a real relief to hear that from someone as close to her as you.

File.name: 03-KB-E09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm going to go for it, even if I've got no chance.
Whatever happens, no hard feelings, okay?
You'll comfort me if she says no, won't you? Haha, just kidding. See you later.
Just what is it... that I want to do...?

File.name: 03-KB-E10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm going to ask Saionji out tomorrow.

File.name: 03-KB-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm almost done over here. How about you?
Ah, I've just got... a little more to do.
Well, I guess you were pretty much done anyway when class was finished.
But it doesn't look like you've made much progress since then, does it?
Is there something worrying you about tomorrow?
No, not at all. Everything's okay.
Nanami's really worked up about the festival, isn't she?
Glow... oh, right. She did mention that she was going with her boyfriend, didn't she?
Given how little fun there is to be had at our school, the festival's pretty much the main event for couples.
Do you know the stories and traditions behind the Sakakino Academy school festival?
You know how each class prepares its own display?
The first of the traditions is to go around and see them together.
It seems going around the school festival together is the same as a confession of love.
I see. Yeah, that could be right.
There's also the legendary break room that's said to exist in several of the class displays every year.
There's a gap in the display. A space where couples can sneak in and be alone together to 'take a break'.
The teachers keep an eye out for them every year, but they always pop up in a few places...
a gap in the corridors with a bed and condoms scattered everywhere.
It's a tradition... a story passed down among the girls.
Yeah. It's always a girl who takes the initiative and leads the boy to the break room.
So when you want to invite someone, you grip your right hand like this... and hold it out in front of you.
No. There's a condom in your hand, and if the boy accepts, he takes it.
The girls' basketball club is doing it this year. Nanami was saying how they were really busy setting up the break room.
I see... the girls' basketball club, huh... I had no idea.
That's because you haven't been hanging out with us lately.
You're going to see the festival together, right?
If you're going to use the break room, then I could ask Nanami where it is.
You haven't done it with Itou yet.
After all... we haven't even... promised to go around together.
Why don't you try calling him now?

File.name: 03-KB-F01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I-if it's just a phone call... I guess that would be okay, right?
Why wouldn't it be? I think he'll probably still be awake at this hour.
B-but he'll already have plans! I'm sure of it!
With whom? Knowing him, there's no way he'd accept an invitation from another girl.
Of course he would! After all, he's going out with Katsura-san...
Okay, I'll just try calling him!
I'll let it ring five times, and if he doesn't pick up, that's it, okay?!
It's settled! All right, I'm going to call him now!

File.name: 03-KB-F02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If you're going to be like that, then some other girl's going to claim him.
That seems to be all that ever happens to him...
Someone's been saying that they saw Itou in Sakakino-cho with a girl from our class. Was that you?
They said it was a girl with long hair, so I didn't think it was you.
Well, I guess it's not important.

File.name: 03-KB-F03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Let's give it our best tomorrow!
You're in the kitchen tomorrow, aren't you?
Yeah. I'll be pouring that tea and slicing up that bread real good.
But your uniform isn't ready yet, right?
Well, I'll be looking forward to it on the day.
Fwah... well, I'm off to sleep.
O-okay. Let's do our best tomorrow!
U-um, hey, listen, he said he was looking forward to seeing me in my waitress uniform.
I'd better do my best on the sewing.
Weren't you going to invite him to walk around together?
I-I'll work on that one tomorrow.

File.name: 03-KB-F04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Why don't you call him one more time?
No, I'm sure he's already asleep.
He's getting ready for tomorrow... he'll be stuck in the kitchen all day.

File.name: 03-KB-F05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm done, so I'm going home now, okay?
You'd better get some sleep too, or you won't last the day tomorrow.
As part of the final festivities, there's a folk dance, and you're supposed to invite a boy to it.
They say that a couple who dances together at the bonfire will stay together for that whole year.
Just for that year? Seems pretty realistic.
It's probably a way out for all the couples that suddenly pop up during that time.
A folk dance, huh... if it's just a folk dance, then...

File.name: 03-KB-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Makoto-kun, would you like to walk around the festival with me...?
Makoto-kun, please come and see the festival with me... Makoto-kun, let's spend the festival together... um... um...
Haah... it's no good... I don't even have the courage to call him.
Onee-chan, Mom's telling you to take a bath now.
Tomorrow... I'll invite him if I see him then.

File.name: 03-KB-H01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, it's the school festival tomorrow, right?

File.name: 03-KB-H04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If I've hurt you, I'm sorry.\nGoodbye.

File.name: 03-KB-I00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: That should be enough for the morning... people on the next shift, please make sure you come back and switch over on time.
I'm counting on all of you.

File.name: 03-KB-I01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sheesh... what's up with that guy?
All of our relief guys have the day off except him, and he goes and disappears...
If he doesn't come back, I'm going to be stuck here in the kitchen forever...
Well, whatever. It's not like I've got anything better to do.

File.name: 03-KB-I02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Do you understand the situation? Torii and Hasegawa aren't here today, so you're my only relief, you know.
Those two were perfectly fine up until yesterday. You wouldn't think that they'd just suddenly get sick, would you?
They did say how much of a pain in the butt the school festival was. They're probably just skipping school.
Yeah? Then I should be able to skip school too, right?
Haah... this is what I get for resisting the urge to skip school.
Got any plans to go around with your girlfriend?
If I had made plans for something big like that, I'd be dying to come to school today.
It would have been no laughing matter if you'd decided to skip school too.
Don't worry, there's no way I'd miss today.
I told you, didn't I? I'm going to invite Saionji.
Just watch me. I'm going to look for her now.

File.name: 03-KB-I03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haah... somehow, it looks like we've made it in time.
It's turned out well, hasn't it?
The break room is done... but do any of us actually have boyfriends?
We're going to find them now!
I-it's fine! We're going to invite them now! Right, Minami?
I see. What about you, Otome-chan?
Shall I have a girl from class 3 call him over?
Like I said before, stop pinning it on class 3!
So, I guess no one has any plans yet, right?
Some of the girls from the basketball club said they'd like to use it.
Ah, don't tell me that you...?
It's not someone from our school... he's a university student I met at my part-time job...
Okay, I'm off to meet him, then.
What, he's already here? What if we'd said no?
...So, she said she wants to use it.
That means she and her boyfriend are already doing it, right?
Gwaah! To think that quiet little girl beat all of us to it!
We ought to get going too.
Ishimaru-senpai from the soccer club, and Ohka-kun from the basketball club... let's try inviting all the nice catches!
Ehh? Isn't that just a little TOO haphazard...?
But we can't lose to Kumi, right?!
Otome's got her mind set on one boy, so that's okay.
Koizumi-san and Mori-san were supposed to man the counter this afternoon...
They've got something more important to do than waiting at a counter!
There'll be no problem if you take over for them, right?
Eh? B-but I've got something to take care of now too...
I'm taking care of the girls' basketball display for the morning.
You'd better do a good job watching the counter.
Oh, and if anyone wants to use the break room, be sure to check if it's empty first, okay?
The break room... you mean that place with the bed... don't you?
That sort of thing isn't right...! If one of the teachers found out, I think they'd be furious...
None of them will if you don't say anything.
If anyone finds out, I'm going to tell everyone that you were the one who squealed.
Then there's no problem, is there?

File.name: 03-KB-I04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Welcome! We've got a very scary haunted house here! Please come on in!
Sheesh... they're under the desk. Take one out.
If I call him or send him an e-mail... he might just... ignore me... again.
I've got to talk to him face to face... but no one's coming back...
Now that it's come to this... I've got to at least ask him to the folk dance... somehow.
Um... mind if I go into the haunted house?
Fwaah?! Ah, yes! P-please, go ahead!
You weren't able to make up with your boyfriend?
I see. Sure is a stubborn guy, isn't he?
N-no! The one to blame... is me.
I was thinking of calling him yesterday... but I couldn't work up the courage.
So, you haven't even called him?
Well, you two aren't going to make up like that.
Yes. You said you were going to invite Saionji-san.
Oh, sure, I'm all set for that.
It's just that I don't know where she is right now.

File.name: 03-KB-I05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What's more... I thought I'd ask Makoto first, so I called him yesterday.
That guy's already got another girlfriend... but it seems he's still attached to Saionji.
Seems like she turned him down, though.
That's why it's weird how he's getting irritated about me asking Saionji out.
Dragging along something from the past like that... it's an insult to his current girlfriend, don't you think?
Still, having said that, I don't even know Saionji's cell phone number, so...

File.name: 03-KB-I06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What's more... Makoto was saying that he'd be the one to go with her.
You think he misunderstood what I meant when I said I was going to ask Saionji out?
He probably thinks I was planning on walking around the festival with her as a good friend.
That's what I think. Deep down, that guy's got a real childish mind.
Anyhow, I'd like to beat him to it, but... I don't even know her cell phone number...

File.name: 03-KB-I07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Come to think of it, I don't even know Saionji's cell phone number.
Given the situation, I guess asking her out might be a bit too much for me after all.

File.name: 03-KB-I08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Shall I ask her to come?
In that case, I'll give her a call.
Yes. Um... Saionji-san, where are you right now?
Um, listen... are you free today?
Ah... you're working at your class' display in the afternoon?
No... I was wondering if you'd made plans to see the festival with anyone.
Ah, that's right. Do you know about the closing festivities today?
Yes, that's right. There'll be a folk dance, like at a campfire... yes.
If... you don't have anyone to dance with at the bonfire...
There's someone who'd like to dance with you... and if it's okay with you, he'd like to meet... haah...
Um, well... first of all, she can't see the festival with anyone. She was free before, but now she's out running errands.
She has to work at her class' store in the afternoon, so her schedule's filled until the festival ends.
So then I asked her about the closing festivities, but...
Well, no... she said that she'll be going to the festivities, so if there IS such a person, he should speak with her there.
Anything else...? No, there was nothing else.
I'm sorry. I may have caused her to misunderstand...
She said she's not interested in any guy who has to confess through a girl.
I'm so sorry! I'll make sure to clear this up with her afterwards!
If you call Saionji-san and speak with her in person, she'll understand... maybe.
I'm sure of it. Saionji-san is a good person, so I'm sure she'll understand if you explain it to her.
Well, I'll give it a shot...
In that case, do you mind if I give Makoto a call too? It's about time I came in to relieve him.
Ah! It's okay if you don't want me to. It's just... I left my phone in the classroom, so I thought maybe I could use yours.
...I don't think Makoto-kun will pick up if it's a call from me.
...Don't tell me that your boyfriend... is Makoto?
I see... okay, I've got it.
I'm going to bring him here.
It just happens to be time for us to switch over. I'll drag him here.
I-it's fine. I don't want to cause you any trouble...
You helped me with Saionji, didn't you? Let me help you with something too.
I'll bring him here for you, but making up with him is your job, okay?

File.name: 03-KB-I09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Right, one slice of bread, two slices of bacon... three salads...
I'm sorry! Now, come with me!
Come with you? What about here?

File.name: 03-KB-I10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Your girlfriend... it's Katsura-san, isn't it?

File.name: 03-KB-J00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Somehow, it feels like I'm low on sugar, so I'm going out to do some shopping.
Ah, if there's something you want, I'll buy it for you.
Itou just said that he has nothing to do today.
B-but I heard that all the boys who're meant to relieve him are away, so he's going to be in the kitchen the whole time...
Are you going to run away?

File.name: 03-KB-J01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sure she went this way...
Did she go over to the building on the other side...?

File.name: 03-KB-K01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Then there's nothing left for me to say!
My sister once told me, 'You'll end up being kicked by a horse.'
W-what the heck does that mean?!
Well, I'm going back now. See you.
'Kicked by a horse'? What's he talking about...? What nonsense.
I think it's probably a proverb.
The one that goes... 'those who interfere in the romances of others...'
Eh?! O-oh, right. '...ought to be kicked by a horse and die', right?
Sure sounds like something his sister would say.

File.name: 03-KB-K02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You were the one who said we should put some distance between ourselves.
Put some distance between ourselves... and once we'd both calmed down a little and come to an understanding...

File.name: 03-KB-K03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, the rest is up to you two. Give it your best.

File.name: 03-KB-K04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hey, if it isn't Itou. What's wrong?
You've come at the perfect time. I was just thinking of calling you over.
Are you free at the moment?

File.name: 03-KB-K05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: R-right! Actually, I just happen to be free too!
So why don't we take a walk around together?
Aren't you going around with Kanroji and the others?
I'm about to meet up with my boyfriend.
And it's time for our shifts at the haunted house.
I see... well, shall we go, then?
Ah! We still haven't finished talking...

File.name: 03-KB-K06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Eh...? But your shift is over, right?
Well, I'm in the middle of a conversation right now.

File.name: 03-KB-K07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What are you thinking so hard about?
Aren't you free? Your shift is over, right?
If you're free... why don't we take a walk around together?
Eh?! It's fine, you go ahead with the girls.
Ah, that won't work. I'm meeting up with my boyfriend.
And we've got to attend to our class display.
I'm the only one who's free. Come on, keep me company.
I see... but I'm in the middle of a conversation right now.
Ah! I-I don't... um, really, it's okay!
Aren't you guys putting a little pressure on her?
Kanroji, do you and Kotonoha know each other?
We're just from the same junior high.
Haah... okay, fine. I'll tag along with you.

File.name: 03-KB-K08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Makoto-kun... what are you doing here?
Weren't you taking a walk around with Katou-san...?
Did you know...? They say that to go around the school festival together... means that you're going out.
Katou and I aren't like that.

I wonder how long it's been since we've been together like this?
Not since junior high, right? We sure raised hell back then, together with all the other guys.
But now we're in different classes, and you're in a club. There's not much left that connects us, is there?
