Well, if you say so. Got enough time left to make one more round? Shall we go somewhere else?
Ah, you don't have to force yourself to go if you're tired. I'm pretty tired, too.

Wait, don't you need to help with the haunted house?

Your tongue... ah! Nn! So good... ahah... nnn!

Don't try to laugh and change the subject.
Nanami! Your boyfriend's here to pick you up.

I'll be back to help later! Bye!
Oh, what does it matter? It's just for today.
We can't spare her, with all the other people absent today.
Still, at least we're able to be together.
I don't know if you can call this chaos 'being together'...
Ah, sorry. I'll get that apple pie out right away!
You can go and take a break.
Are you serious? But my relief is still...
I see. Okay, I'll take a short break, then.
Hikari and I will be here, and Katsu-san and the others are coming too.
I see... well, I'll take you up on your offer, then.

You really do enjoy taking care of Sekai, don't you?
Even though she looks like she should be the one taking care of you. How very strange.
Uh-huh... but as long as Itou pays attention to her, it's fine.
Yep, that's right. The time's come for you to part with your beloved daughter.
Stop being stupid and start taking care of Sekai's work too.

File.name: 03-SA-B10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: This is... uwah. Has this been used...?
Um... don't feel too bad about everything, okay?
Time heals all sorrows, after all... and I mean, I'd be happy to heal them for you right now.
There's no need to get cranky.
Getting cranky won't cause him to come back to you, you know. You ought to be looking for someone new.
He WILL come back! He's just made a mistake. He really... does love me...
Just as I thought... you can't forget about him after all.
That's the way I prefer to be.
She'll fall in love with you if you just force yourself onto her.
More importantly, Sawanaga-san... everyone's now under the mistaken impression that you're my boyfriend...
Is there some way we can resolve this misunderstanding...?
No! I... I'm already going out with someone!
He dumped you! Give up on him already!
He hasn't dumped me! Kyah...! No!
The guy you were going out with... was Makoto?
Yes! So... please! Let go of me!
If you're talking about Makoto, then he's getting friendly with Saionji right about now!
Makoto and Saionji are going out together.
That's... a lie! Saionji-san... Saionji-san would...
Saionji-san and Makoto-kun just made a mistake... I'll forgive them...! So...!
Oh, so you knew they were going out all along.
They're not going out! They're not...!
I'll make you forget about him.
H-hey, I really do like you, you know. Seriously, why don't we go out together?

File.name: 03-SA-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Minami, is it true that it's finished?
Yeah, this is meant to be a secret from the boys.
It's... a real bed, isn't it?
Totally feels like a love hotel, doesn't it?
If it really was a love hotel, it'd be more like...
Have you been to one before?
Are you sure no one's going to find out about this place?
Hmm... well, it's covered, and the music's turned all the way up, so you can't hear what's going on inside.
Well, at least that's what the girls' basketball club says.
Wow, so this is what it's like.
I didn't help with the construction, so this the first time I've seen it... pretty incredible, huh?
Isn't it? Hey, you're going to be inviting someone too, aren't you?
How about that guy that you like?
U-uh... I don't know. I think he'd probably refuse.
No way. There's no boy who'd refuse after a confession from you.
Don't worry about what Katsura said.
She's just making stuff up because she's popular with the boys.
She's probably just messing with you because she knows you like him. Don't let her get the best of you!
Sheesh... c-come on, we won't make it in time for the opening if we just stand around talking.
Okay, then, let's get things started.
Oh, that's right. The girls from basketball said they'd be coming by later.
We're about to get ready to open...
Oh, shut up. We're just about to start.
Stop nagging us about every little thing. We're working at our own pace.
You're short on chairs over at the reception desk, aren't you?
B-but Kobuchi-san and the others just went to get chairs.
Oh, shut up. Hurry up and go get some!
B-but the shed's already locked, and I don't know where to find extra chairs...
You're on the implementation committee. It's your job.
Yes. It's... a bed, isn't it?
Yep. I think you understand what it's for.
What's more, you understand what'll happen if you squeal to the teachers, don't you?
Hey, why don't you use it too?
You and Itou are going out, aren't you?
What's wrong? Don't tell me you lied to us before?
I... didn't lie, but... right now...
If you weren't lying, then you'll be able to bring him here, right?
Of course you can. Itou's shift is just for the morning, so he's free in the afternoon.
How did you know that, Otome-chan...?
What's wrong? Come on, bring him here.
Oh, dear. Looks like you were lying after all. Of course, there's no way Itou would go out with someone like you.
I wasn't lying! Makoto-kun... really did say... that we were going out.
What? Are you admitting that you're a liar, then?
F-fine. You go ahead and do that.

File.PrintText: Every year, the classes take turns preparing these behind the backs of the teachers.
I see... I had no idea.
That's only natural. It seems this is something only the girls know about.
The girls invite the boys they like here during the festival, and then... they come together. It's like a secret ceremony.
You can do... whatever you like...
Everything... that you want to do...

File.name: 03-SA-C02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haah... looks like things are finally calming down.
That's because the festival's almost over.
All that's left is the bonfire!
Ahh! Nanami! You skipped your shift, didn't you?
Eheheh... my boyfriend and I got carried away.
I'll bet you were getting pretty carried away yourself, weren't you, Sekai?
Which break room did you use? I used the one next door in class 4.
You didn't use a break room?
There's a little room with a bed behind the wall of each display. You're supposed to invite your boyfriend there.
Uwah! An indecent place like that? At our school?!
We'll start cleaning up soon, so you two can go now.
Eh? You're going to be cleaning up, right? I'll help.
It'll be the bonfire right after we finish.
In other words, 'If you've got a boyfriend, then get the hell out of here and meet up with him.'
We really had a hard time here thanks to you, Nanami. You'll have to treat us to something later.
Seriously? I wonder what I should ask for. I've got to think this over...
Eheheh... well, you can go now.
Okay, I'll be going on ahead, then. What about you, Sekai?
I think I'll wait for a while.
I think he'll be coming soon.
Did you make proper plans to meet up?
Yeah. We're going to dance together at the bonfire.

File.PrintText: Sorry, I hope I didn't keep you waiting long. ...Wait, there's no one here. I guess it took longer than I thought.

What are you talking about? Come on, let's go to the bonfire. We promised each other, didn't we?
I'm not going... because I can't.
What do you mean, 'you can't'...? Did something happen?!
Crying... while being surrounded by girls from her class... and being called a liar...
Katsura-san said she was going out with you, and everyone told her to prove it... and then...
She kept saying, 'Makoto is coming,' but you didn't come... and she still kept believing in you!
And here I am... treading all over her feelings and having fun with you...!
It's awful! I'm a terrible person! I...
I'm... someone... who does horrible things like this...
...and I've... come to hate myself for it.
You've got to go and see Katsura-san!

File.PrintText: You've forgotten how I feel, haven't you?

But I want to go out with you, not Kotonoha.

But if I had to choose, I'd choose you. For sure.
So please, don't ignore my feelings and tell me to go and see Kotonoha.
Or... is it that you hate me now?
No! I love you more than anyone else!
I'm not going to hesitate any longer.
Because I love you so much...

File.PrintText: You... don't care about how I feel at all, do you?
You care more about Kotonoha's feelings than mine!

It's not anything urgent. I'd just like you to come somewhere with me today...

So... I can't go with you.
You can come after you've gone with Saionji-san.

Those girls from class 4 were having an argument.
I know. What's the deal with her?
Seems like she was boasting about having a boyfriend, and then the others were like, 'Then call him over.'
Yeah, there's no room for excuses if your man doesn't come during the school festival.
Look... we're asking you WHEN he's going to get here.
If we don't know when he's coming, we can't go out and see the festival.
Isn't she just planning to lie and say he came while we were gone?
Is that what you were planning to do?!
Then just what ARE you going to do?!
That's impossible. The festival's going to end in about an hour. There's no way he'd be busy up until now.
Could it be that she just lied about calling him?
Uwah... are we going that far back? We're not going to forgive you if you didn't actually invite him.
I did call him... I called him, but... he... must have something he has to do.
Aww, sheesh! She's really starting to piss me off!
Just admit it. You aren't going out with Itou.

File.name: 03-SA-F03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The truth is... I ran into Itou before I got here.
I asked him if he had any plans for today.
Have you made plans with anyone after this?
His story and yours are a little different.
He said that he hadn't made plans with Katsura.
Looks like it's a confirmed lie.
You idiot, there's no way he will! Give it up already!
Come on, this is starting to make us look like bullies.

File.name: 03-SA-F04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Listen, why don't you just apologize to everyone?
Just say you're sorry for boasting and lying to us.

File.name: 03-SA-F06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Give it up, Katsura. There's a limit to how much patience we have.
What are you guys doing, gathered around Katsura-san like that?
Yes, it... well, okay, maybe not. But either way, you shouldn't be picking on Katsura-san!
What? Don't tell me that you like her?
Ah... shut up! What are you talking about?!
Could it be that Katsura's boyfriend is really Sawanaga?
Look, you've gone and made him depressed. You shouldn't be saying sad things like that.
We're not really picking on Katsura here.
I'm not lying. Katsura said she'd bring her boyfriend, so we waited... but he's still not here, and we're tired of waiting.
Katsura's looking pretty down at having been stood up. Why don't you be her boyfriend instead?
You'd be saving her some face, and I'm sure you'd be satisfied too.
It's obvious just looking at you. You like Katsura, don't you?
It's settled, then. Follow my lead, okay?
Well, it seems I misunderstood after all! Katsura-san!
You said you'd show us your boyfriend, right?
I'm sorry, it seems like I was confused about who your boyfriend was.
You're going out with Sawanaga, aren't you?
Your boyfriend came after all, so I guess we lose!
Eh? But her boyfriend is Itou...
Well, that's that, guys. Sorry for causing such a fuss!
Um, it's really not like that... I'm not going out with Sawanaga-san.
It seems Katsura still hasn't accepted the fact that she's been dumped.
That's why you need to comfort her... if we set you two up as a couple, then she really will fall for you.
There's a little room back there. Why don't you two spend some time talking it over in there?
We don't need to use something like that just to talk!
Listen, that girl is a virgin, okay?
Eh...?! How do you know that?
We're both girls. Of course I know.
So you've got to force her, even if she doesn't want to go through with it.
Of course she won't want to. Your first time hurts, you know? Sometimes there's even blood. No girl looks forward to that.
I see... come to think of it, my sister once cried because her boyfriend forced her into it...
See? That's why you can't give up, even if she resists.
That's what you call being a real man.
If you take her even by force, she'll fall for you.
It's not crazy... or what, are you too scared to do her?
Like hell I am! Fine, I'll do it.
Sawanaga wants to talk to you about what happened earlier.
You'll attract attention out here, so you can use the room in the back.
It's fine. No one's using it now, and you've got to resolve this misunderstanding with Sawanaga, right?
No problem. Off you go, then.

File.name: 03-SA-F07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hey, Makoto! What's with the crowd?

File.name: 03-SA-F10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Aren't you just passing through here?

File.name: 03-SA-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: That girl was from class 4, wasn't she?
We've known each other since junior high.
No, you idiot. Just someone I used to play with.
We don't hang out much anymore.
So don't let it bother you.
I-it doesn't bother me one bit!

File.name: 03-SA-G01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Those were the eyes of someone in love.
What are you talking about? We're just friends from junior high.
You're so thickheaded, Makoto. She's in love with you.
You're thinking too hard about it.
Well... I'm happy that you're jealous.
Sheesh... there you go again, changing the subject.
Not at all... you're the one that I love.

File.name: 03-SA-G02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Can you tell... when we're like this?
...Can you tell how I feel, too?

File.name: 03-SA-G03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Thanks to you, we've managed to find somewhere quiet to do this even during the school festival.

File.name: 03-SA-G06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Oh, don't think so hard about it.

File.name: 03-SA-G07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm so happy to be with such a cute, wonderful girl.
I'm really happy to be with you too.

File.name: 03-SA-G08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: No... no, we can't... we're on our break...

File.name: 03-SA-G09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: No...! Not even if you say things like that... haahn!

File.name: 03-SA-G10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So you say... but you're feeling it.
That's... because you know... my sensitive spots.
I'll make you feel it even more.

File.name: 03-SA-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Don't do something like that if you're going to space out.
Come on! Now that we've enjoyed a change of pace, let's head back to class.

File.name: 03-SA-H01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I can't let these clothes get dirty...
I'll take care not to dirty them.
I'm not lying. I'll make sure...
...to take them off without getting them dirty.
In this case... we ought to be able to make it back without being too late.
You dummy... I'm not talking to you anymore.
...Aren't you going to beg for it?
What do you want me to do with it?
Nhaah...! Haah... put it in... and thrust it around...!
The festival's about to end, isn't it...?
It's all because you wanted to do it so many times.
I got fired up over how different you looked in your waitress uniform.
Sheesh... I wonder if it's going to leak out before we get back to class.
All because someone squirted so much inside me.
Shall I plug you up one more time, then?
Well, I'll be heading back now. You can take it easy and have a walk around.
Really? I could go back with you...
I'll be okay. Ah, but come with me to the bonfire, okay?
The one with the folk dance?
A folk dance, huh... sounds like a pain.
Come along, even if it is.
Is there something special about it?
There's a meaning behind the folk dance at the bonfire.
Meaning? You mean that thing about how couples who dance at the bonfire won't break up?
There's that too, but the bonfire is like an event for couples to make their debut.
You mean, like a declaration throughout the school that we're going out?
I want to do it. I know it's really selfish and egotistic to think so, but... deep down in my heart, you're still not...
So, please! I want to become your real girlfriend.

File.name: 03-SA-H03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ooh, stop dodging the question like that.
I said I'd think about it.
You can't just 'think about it'. I-T'S A P-R-O-M-I-S-E!
For sure! Really! Seriously! Please! See you there!

File.name: 03-SA-H04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I won't force you to come... if you don't want to.
Don't give up so quickly, you idiot!
The bonfire, right? I'll go, so just hurry up and get back to class.

File.name: 03-SA-I01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I... wanted to dance the folk dance... with you..
I know, you must be tired!

File.name: 03-SA-J01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: S... see?! Just like I thought. Sheesh, you almost had me there.
I'm sorry. I've wanted to apologize to you all this time... but I couldn't tell you.

File.name: 03-SA-J03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I... was so worried... I thought that maybe... you wouldn't come...
You've been through so much... gone to such trouble... all because of me. I've wanted to apologize to you all this time.
I'm the one who should be...!
No... I'm just... so glad that you came...!
I'll... work hard... to become the kind of girl you'll love... so...

File.name: 03-SA-J04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry that I became scared and avoided you! It was my fault that you ended up making a mistake... but that's all!
That's... not... how you really feel!
Please... let me keep being your girlfriend.

File.name: 03-SA-J06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: By the looks of things just then, it seems they really were going out...
Let's go. It looks like Katsura was just dumped for real. It'd be going too far to make fun of her now.
Um... sorry. I know it sounds strange... but cheer up.
Hmmn hmn hmmmn hmmn... huh? Katsura-san?
What's wrong? What are you doing here? Oh, cleaning up the haunted house? Just leave that for cleanup day tomorrow.
That person you were seeing the festival with... is he...?
But the bonfire's about to start... did he go on ahead?
I... don't have anyone to dance with anymore...
He's not here... uu... uuuh... kuh..

File.name: 03-SA-J07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: There's no helping it. Let's retreat.
You can use the room at the back.

File.name: 03-SA-J08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hey, do you think he'll really come?
Who knows? It'd be more interesting if he didn't.
Some girls from class 4 are having an argument.
Yeah, that girl with the huge breasts. What about her?
She bragged to the other girls about going out with Itou from class 3, so they told her to prove it!
You know, the guy who hangs with Sawanaga.
Yeah, the guy who always went around doing stupid stuff with Shiba back in junior high.
He had such a crush on Mori.
Remember how he cried at graduation when he heard she was going out with Shiba? It was so gross.
But forget Sawanaga. Don't you think Itou's kind of cute?
Yeah, yeah! There are girls in our class who've been checking him out too.
We can't have Katsura going out with him.
You said it. I hope she's lying... then he's all mine!
Whoa, talk about putting your cards on the table!
If we don't know when he's coming, we can't go enjoy the festival.
If we leave now, I bet she'll say he came while we were gone.
Maybe she didn't even ask him to come. Maybe she's been lying to us the whole time.
The whole time!? If we find out you didn't even ask him, you're gonna pay.
I did ask him... I did. I'm sure he just... has things to do.
Okay, now she's really getting on my nerves!
Haven't you taken this far enough?
Just admit it. You and Itou aren't a couple.
Everyone's already seen through your lies.

File.name: 03-SA-J09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The truth is... I ran into Itou before I got here.
I asked him if he had any plans for today.
Have you made plans with anyone after this?
His story and yours are a little different.
He said that he hadn't made plans with Katsura.
Looks like it's a confirmed lie.
You idiot, there's no way he will! Give it up already!
Come on, this is starting to make us look like bullies.

File.name: 03-SA-J10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Listen, why don't you just apologize to everyone?
Just say you're sorry for boasting and lying to us.
Okay, we've got a confirmed liar here!
Why did she stick it out all the way until the end?
You'll do the packing up tomorrow by yourself, won't you? We're exhausted from having to stick around you all day.
Sheesh... we would have let you off if you'd just honestly admitted that you and Itou weren't going out.
Makoto-kun and I... are going out.
Makoto-kun... is angry right now... but he really does love me... and I know he'll just smile and forgive me later... kuh!

File.name: 03-SB-A01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ever since that day... when Sekai and I came together...
We started going to each other's house almost every day, just to hook up.
Ahh...! Ahh... haah...! Ahh... ah... ahhh!

File.name: 03-SB-A03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Before we knew it, this was how we were, going behind the backs of everyone else...
I... I'm going to... ah...! Ah!
I'm sorry! The student rep meeting just dragged on.

File.name: 03-SB-A04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haah... the setting sun sure is beautiful.
Kanroji and the others really think that we're going out, don't they?
Yeah. They've all known me for a long time... it was obvious to them how I felt.
That's why they thought that we've been going out ever since we started having lunch together. What a problem that was.
Even though your real girlfriend is Katsura-san.

File.name: 03-SB-A06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yes, it can... after all, I love you.
Just kidding. I made you worry. Eheheh.
No, I'm the one who's made a mess of things for you.

File.name: 03-SB-A07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You aren't saying anything, are you?

File.name: 03-SB-A08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The preparations for the bonfire have now been completed. Those attending, please gather on the grounds. Furthermore...
It went by fast, didn't it?
But... there IS something that's a little satisfying.
Did you know that a boy and girl who go around the festival together are deemed to be a confirmed couple?
Just for today, I enjoyed that feeling of being a couple to the fullest.
Ahaha... actually, I'd love for us to go to the folk dance at the bonfire, but that'd just be going too far.
Did you know? There's this superstition that says the couples who dance at the bonfire won't break up that year.
There's something peculiarly believable about that 'that year' part, isn't there? What do you think?

File.name: 03-SB-A09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: W-we can't. Like I said before, the bonfire is something couples go to...
Yeah. We can hear the sound of the folk dance just as well from here.
There won't be an audience, of course... but on the other hand, I'll be able to stay with you the whole time.
The way you... keep suggesting the things I want to do...
After all... they're things I want to do too.

File.name: 03-SB-A10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I've got to go to the bonfire.

File.name: 03-SB-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The next one... is the express at 42 past, huh. It should be here soon.
That's a bit of a wait.

File.name: 03-SB-C03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm glad you waited for me.
Once the school festival is over... I'd like us to go out and have fun together again.
Together with you. Just the two of us...

File.name: 03-SB-C04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I called you yesterday, but your line was busy. I thought about calling you again, but I fell asleep before I could.
That's all right. I wasn't in a hurry, since I could just see you in the morning.
So, what I wanted to say was...
It's the school festival tomorrow, isn't it?
Yes, that's right. Our class is very busy right now.
Same here. Why does everyone leave things to the last minute?
I'll be frantically cutting cake and making tea tomorrow in the kitchen.
You're on the preparation committee, so you'll be busy too, right?
Would you like to take a walk around together?

File.name: 03-SB-C06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'll be stuck in the kitchen all day, remember?
Eh...? You mean there's no one to relieve you?
Aren't you in the same situation?
That's true... there might be no one to relieve me.
After the festival ends, there's a bonfire held on the school grounds.
If we could... dance the folk dance there together...
Me, dancing a folk dance, huh...

File.name: 03-SB-C07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: After all, I may be stuck at the reception desk all day myself...
That's true. We'll both be busy during the festival.

File.name: 03-SB-C08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Let's spend some time together, even if it's just at the bonfire.

File.name: 03-SB-C09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm not good at that sort of thing.

File.name: 03-SB-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I really got into a panic today.
All because you had to come inside me. When it started leaking out while I was with Katsura-san, I didn't know what to do!
Sorry, but if I came outside you, it'd have gotten onto your uniform, and then it would have been even more obvious.
And besides... it was so hot inside you... and so comfortable... I couldn't hold back.
Ooh, there you go again, saying things like that...

File.name: 03-SB-D01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I-it's okay, I'm going to take a bath now.
Be sure to wash on the inside, too.

File.name: 03-SB-D02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sorry, I've got a call waiting.
It's okay, I'm going to take a bath now.
Be sure to wash on the inside too.

File.name: 03-SB-D03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah, speaking of which, did you know that yesterday on TV...

File.name: 03-SB-E00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: That's right... after all, Katsura-san is his girlfriend...

File.name: 03-SB-E01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I wonder if it was from Katsura-san...?
Haah... I can't stand this depressing feeling deep down in my chest.

File.name: 03-SB-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The number you have dialed is currently busy. Please try again later or leave a message after the tone...
It's Kotonoha. I'll call again. Good night.
Onee-chan, the bath is... hey, what are you sighing about?
Ahh... problems with your love life. Is it that boyfriend of yours?
Oh, be quiet and go away.
It's... just a little phone call...
And yet, I'm still nervous... haah...

File.name: 03-SB-F01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry, do you have a moment now?
Um... tomorrow's the construction for the school festival, isn't it?
And the day after that is the school festival, right?
Would you like to... take a walk around the festival together?!

File.name: 03-SB-F02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What would be the point in lying?
All right. We'll see the festival together.
I'll be helping out with our class display in the morning until 1 PM. How about you?
Ah... I should be tending to our class reception until around then, too... but...
...I just thought about what would happen if my relief didn't come... I may be at the reception the whole time.
Haha... I'm sure that won't happen.
I'll come and meet you at the reception after one.

File.name: 03-SB-F03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'll be tied up with our class display.
The bonfire? You mean that campfire-like thing at the end with the folk dance?
Yes. Would you... like to dance?

File.name: 03-SB-F04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: O-oh, right. Sorry. What were you saying?
Would you like to see the school festival together?
Oh, right, the school festival. Well...

File.name: 03-SB-F05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah, I should be free for at least the bonfire.
Y-yes, you're right. After all, even I'll be free, and I'm an implementation committee member!
In that case, let's dance together.

File.name: 03-SB-F06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I don't really like that kind of stuff.
I'm not interested in getting together in a circle with everyone and dancing.
We live in a practical age. No one's reading stories about dancing with tigers under the moon anymore. It's just dull.
Y-yes, you may be right, but... it's a tradition.
Please... I... want to dance with you!

File.name: 03-SB-F07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I really, really... want to dance with you at the folk dance!

File.name: 03-SB-F09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I had no idea you liked folk dances so much.
Ah, no, it's not that I like folk dances. It's actually a school tradition that...
O-oh, nothing. I'm just happy that you promised to dance with me.
Aww, fine, I get it. I promise.
Okay, then, I'm going to sleep now.
Ah, yes. Well, good night, then.

File.name: 03-SB-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Okay! Two sets of cake with black tea!
Next are this one and this one!
Let's see... three coffees, a cream pastry, two apple pies...
And then there're this and this!
Damn it, I'm way too busy...
Thank God... so it's time to change over?
Yeah. Just leave the rest to me!
Oh, I went to the play at the gym... and the film society's self-produced movie.
What's with that look of pity?

File.name: 03-SB-G01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, for me, it'll be after the festival's over.
The folk dance at the bonfire.
Are you serious?! Damn it, I'm envious...
The folk dance is an event for couples.
Tradition has it that if you invite the person you love, the two of you will live happily ever after!
Too slow! What are you doing?!
Sawanaga? What are you doing here?
Then hurry up and get started.
Uwah! This many...? This'll be tough.
You're free until the bonfire, right? Help me out.
Going around the festival by yourself is boring. Take my word for it.
That does sound pretty convincing, coming from someone so experienced in being lonely...

File.name: 03-SB-G02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Geh! R-right. Come to think of it, you've got a girlfriend, don't you? ...Tsk. Hurry up and go.

File.name: 03-SB-G03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, you've got Saionji, so get lost and start making out with her!

File.name: 03-SB-G04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: That's what I want to hear.
Right. I'll take care of the cake-cutting.
Okay, and I'll be in charge of the cake-eating!
Okay, I'll feed you as many rounds of cake as... what are you, stupid?!
Okay, I get it. I'll take care of the drinks.
Hey, your powerful new assistant's here!
Okay, it's time to boil the hell out of this tea!
Okay, then, here's the next order!
Haah... things are finally calming down.
Yeah, you really helped us out.
Yeah. Here, as a sign of my gratitude, I'll give you this custard cake.
Hey, that's supposed to be for sale!
We should be cleaning up so... ah, Itou.
I see... Itou, have you got a moment?
So you are. Hmmn... that waitress uniform of yours...

File.name: 03-SB-G05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What are you thinking so hard about?
Here's the next order. Ah, Sawanaga.
Wait, isn't it time for your shift anyway? And you're 10 minutes late, too.
Where are you going now, Itou?
It doesn't seem like he's got anything to do. Let's make him help us.
If you're free, then help us with something else.
Buying ingredients for our stock. We've run out of sandwich bread and potato salad.
Go and meet up with the girl who's gone on ahead.
The supermarket in front of the station. She'll put the things in order while waiting for you.
Putting them in order? There's that much stuff...? Okay, understood.
We'll leave it to you, then.
We're waiting on the sandwiches, so change them to 'sold out'.
Okay. What's wrong? Did the supermarket run out too?
Haah... all right. But what are we going to do? Isn't it Sekai's turn to relieve you after this?
It's okay. I can keep working.
From: Setsuna\nTitle: Re:\nDon't come back! I've sent Itou your way. Setsuna

File.name: 03-SB-G06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: My relief... we decided at the meeting beforehand that we should change over once every hour.
The truth is, someone else should have been sitting here in the morning, too.
But no one's coming. Not before I came to check up on things and took over the reception, and not afterwards, either...
I'm sorry... it doesn't seem like I can go... and after I forced you to come with me, too...
Katou and the others are from class 4, aren't they?
Aren't they supposed to be looking after the reception?
Obuchi-san and Koizumi-san had shifts, but...
Come on, you said it yourself. If we found him, then you'd...
Well, we've found him, so you'd better resign yourself to it.
Can I talk to you for a second?
Listen, those two girls who are with you...
I want to talk to you about them.
Well, it wouldn't be right for me to tell them... can I ask you to do it instead?
I can't tell if you say 'both'... which one, if you had to choose?!
Uh, hold on for a second.
Which one's taking the next shift?
Let's see... Koizumi-san had the morning shift, and Obuchi-san has the next shift.
Thanks. Hold on for just a little longer.
Itou, do you and Katsura know each other?
Now, we were talking about 'which one', weren't we?
Ehh?! You mean all this time, Natsumi's...?
So, Koizumi's first name is Natsumi.
Eh? You don't even know her name...?
Yeah, of course not. She's from the class next door.
I-I see. So it's still just one-sided...?
It's not that she's good. She's bad!
Well, to be precise, it's more like she'll become bad at this rate.
Yep. By Minami, you mean Obuchi, right? So... I wanted to talk to you so that she won't become bad.
Sorry, I can't be a part of that kind of discussion!
You probably came to me not knowing anything... but I've got feelings too, and I won't compromise them!
But this has nothing to do with you.
...Listen, it's true that they were walking together with you,
but I'm not thinking that you skipped your shift because they talked you into it, so you can relax.
It seems Kotonoha's been anxiously sitting here all morning at the reception.
I wanted to have the people who skipped their shifts take the next shift,
and it just so happened that the two of them came by... so would you mind asking them to swap over?
Yeah. For sitting at the reception.
W-what is it? What's wrong, Katou?
Why do we have to sit at the reception?
Because this is all your fault!

File.name: 03-SB-G07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah. Sit down at that counter over there.
Actually, I'd like a place for two.
...We went to the same junior high school.
Well, just show us our seats... ah, it looks like that one's free. Can we take it?
Isn't Itou taking his break now?
A girl from my junior high school, Katsura. She's a wimp, but a hit with the boys, so the other girls always shunned her.
And now she's set her sights on Itou?
I think she should be back from shopping soon.
Sekai doesn't know about Katsura and Itou, does she?
Our class has the most delicious cakes.
There's this girl whose family runs a cake store, and their lemon custard cake is so famous that they've been on TV.
Ahh... I think I may have seen that.
See? And just between us, the girls all went to her house and baked these cakes with the help of her parents.
They're serious about this, aren't they?
Oh, it's getting late. I'll make our order now. Let's see...
You've got to be kidding. I've been working until just now.

File.name: 03-SB-G08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I guess there's no helping it...
I'm going to pull out when there are fewer customers and we have some breathing room, okay?
No, you'll work for the whole time...
That's fine. Thanks for the help.
Well... sorry, but I'm going to give them a hand for a little while.
I'll be done soon, so just hang in there for a bit.
We need to talk. You've got time, haven't you?
Next up are three custard cake sets and two coffees. After that...
Wah! Wait wait wait! I'll do them in order!
Why are we so busy, anyway?
It didn't look crowded enough outside for all these crazy orders to be coming in...
Stop looking away and start working.
Let's see... okay, here are three custard cake sets and two coffees! What's next?
No kidding about the 'hard' part. See you later.
Sorry to keep you waiting, Kotonoha.
Yeah. If you're after Katsura, she left saying she had something urgent to do.
That can't be right... did she mention what that 'something' was?
The... the 'something', huh... let's see... she may have... or maybe she didn't...

File.name: 03-SB-G10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's not that I can't... but I just got off my shift, you know?
C-come on, you were helping us just now, so you'd know. The kitchen gets really busy as soon as the customers increase.
So, just for a little while...

File.name: 03-SB-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: No problem. Good thing Katou came along at just the right time.
Back in junior high, the boys and girls always did stupid stuff together. She's one of the people I used to hang out with.
We all went our separate ways once we graduated,
but Katou and I ended up in the same school... sure brings back memories. I should have invited the guys to the festival.
Ah... sorry. I was just lost in nostalgia for a second. Where shall we go?
Is there a place you'd like to go?

File.name: 03-SB-H01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: No, I was just starting to get hungry. I'll be looking forward to it.

File.name: 03-SB-H03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: The place that you wanted to go...?

File.name: 03-SB-H04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Is there anywhere that you'd like to go?
I... yes, the fortune teller over there.
Ah, that one in the classroom ahead of us.
Do you like fortune telling and stuff?
Not all that much... but as much as anyone else.
What sort of fortune telling do you usually do?
'Do'...? Well, I usually ask for Grebel or Choushinri Shugosei... just the usual stuff.
I-I'm not sure if I understand, but that's supposed to be 'normal'?
It's only normal for a girl to have her fortune told, you know.
Well, I guess you could be right. Girls do like fortune telling, after all... so shall we have our fortunes told?

File.name: 03-SB-H05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Makoto-kun, is it a bother for you to walk around with me like this?
N-not at all! Uh, let's see...

File.name: 03-SB-H06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...In her own way, I think Nanami was showing us some consideration.
She thinks that you and I are going out.
Hey, why don't we go to the usual place?

File.name: 03-SB-H07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Makoto. Were you waiting for me? I'm about to go on my b...
Class 3 certainly is amazing, isn't it? They're so popular that they can't keep up with all the orders.
Did you go out to buy more supplies?
We were thinking of stopping by for some tea, but it seemed like you were busy, so we went somewhere else.
Well, please give it your best, Saionji-san.

File.name: 03-SB-H08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Is there a particular place you'd like to go?
Yeah. We've been to class 3's shop, which is where I wanted to go. Now it's your turn, right?
Do you have a place in mind?
Well, you ARE a girl, after all. There's something cute about fortune telling, isn't there?
Eheheh... really? Actually, I really like fortune telling.

File.name: 03-SB-H09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, Taisuke was all, 'Make out with Sekai!', but...

File.name: 03-SB-H10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Maybe I should have gone around with Kotonoha instead...
Nothing much. My shift for class just ended, so I'm deciding what to do now.
Then go on and tell him.
What is it? Have you got a problem with me or something?
I don't remember doing anything to upset the girls from class 4. We've never really had much contact.
I'm telling you, that's not it.
Actually! It just so happens that I'm free now, too!
I'll pass. Going around with girls would only tire me out.
Ah! We've got some stuff to take care of now, so we won't be going with you.
It's our shift back at our class display. Right, Minami?
So, everyone from class 4 is helping with the class display.
I heard your class was scattered all over the place, and everyone was just doing what they wanted...
Really? So it's just you who's free, then?
I guess you could say that.
Let's take a walk around and have some fun, then, just like old times.

File.name: 03-SB-I01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Something for the committee? She's on the implementation committee, after all.
I see. I guess urgent stuff comes up for committee members all the time.
I guess there's no helping it. I'll wait at class 4 until she gets back, then.
Come on, out of the way. I'm going to class 4.
You don't need me for anything else, right? I'm going now.
S-she said this matter for the committee was going to take a long time!
I wonder what it's about? Is the committee pushing some task onto her again...?
And so, she said that you should just walk around and enjoy yourself...
...I see. Well, guess it can't be helped.
So, you've got some free time now, right?
Why not?! Now that Katsura's gone, you should have nothing left to do, right?!
She might come back. I'll wait.
There's no need to wait for someone like her!
I mean, Katsura said that you didn't have to wait!
I see... I wonder if it's one of those things that just drags on...
Okay, then. Since I've got nothing to do, I might as well go and help.
Waah! Y-you'll just cause trouble for her!
No, I won't. I'll just go and take a look now.

File.name: 03-SB-I02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I see... being on the implementation committee, she must get all sorts of bothersome stuff passed on to her.
I guess those guys in class 4 are making her do all the work again. I'll talk to Katou and have her do something about it.
K-Katou's the one from the girls' basketball club, right?
You two know each other? That's a surprise!
We're from the same junior high school.
Well, whatever. I'm heading over to class 4 for a bit.

File.name: 03-SB-I03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well, it doesn't matter. I'll just ask her in person.
What are you doing here at the reception again?
Did those girls from before run away?
There's no way you accepted this voluntarily. Did someone force you to do it?
What are you talking about? Cause trouble for whom?
Me?! You aren't causing any trouble for me!
Did someone in my class say something to you?
What did Kanroji say to you?
She said to stay away from you, because you were going to see the festival with another girl...
I don't have any plans like that. Don't worry about it.
She said that I should realize... that I was causing trouble for you...
I'm... so insensitive when it comes to things like this... I'm sorry...
You aren't causing me any trouble.
Who do you believe? Me or Kanroji?
Well, I guess it's better to have you join us than tell the teachers.
I knew it. You look all nice and well-behaved, but... hehe...
If she thinks that I'm your boyfriend, then I don't really...
The truth is... there's a special space set up inside this haunted house.
Not just here... but apparently in several other classes, too...
The other girls were saying that it's a tradition here at this school.
A tradition? I've never heard of it.
It's only a tradition among the girls... a secret ceremony passed down between them.
A ceremony, huh... I see. So?
Well... they say that if a girl invites a boy into that place, they can become a real couple...
You extend your hand like this... to the boy you like...
And if the boy is willing to go with that girl... he takes her hand.
And then...! In the back, the two of them are alone, and they...!
The two of them... become... a real couple!
I...! If it's with you... no...! Because... I want us to... be a real couple... I...!

File.name: 03-SB-I04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm sorry... it feels as though it's my fault.
It's not your fault. Those guys are just unreasonable.
Let's go. If they're desperate enough to ask me for help, they're probably having trouble keeping up with orders.

File.name: 03-SB-I05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: H-hold on for just one second! She's almost...
Sorry! It took me a while to find the potato salad.
I'm really sorry. Thanks for waiting.
Well, I'm on break now, so I'll be going.
You don't have anything left to do now that you've finished shopping, right?
Perfect. The two of you can go take a walk together, then.
Uuu... well, I don't mind. What about you, Sekai?

File.name: 03-SB-I06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It would have been better to have just chased him away from here instead of focusing on breaking them apart.
Itou was the one dragging his heels about our request. We weren't in a position to do anything else.

File.name: 03-SB-I07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Oh, Kioura. Have you seen Sekai?
If you're looking for Sekai, she'll be coming back soon.
I asked her to go out and do some shopping.
Sorry, it took a little while!
I couldn't find the potato salad, so I went around looking for it. Here.
Mmn. Good work. By the way...
You've got nothing left to do, right?
Itou wanted to know if you'd like to take a walk around with him.
No, but... I hadn't even said anything to you.
Well, I've got free time now too, so...

File.name: 03-SB-I08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haha... oh, by the way, Sekai...

File.name: 03-SB-I09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: And the skirt is short, too.
Haha, sorry... oh, by the way, Sekai...

File.name: 03-SB-I10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I was just a little captivated.
Oooh! There you go again, saying stuff like that!
Haha... oh, by the way, Sekai...

File.name: 03-SB-J00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Phew... sorry to keep you waiting.
I wasn't able to go around with you during the day, so I figured you'd come here.
And you did say it was an event for couples...
Come on, let's go and dance.

File.name: 03-SB-K00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Well... it's getting pretty late, so there's not much that's left.
Well, somewhere nice and quiet would be good.
Somewhere nice and quiet, huh... ah, I know.
Hmn? Is there a place like that?

File.name: 03-SB-L00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Why don't we take a walk around together?
The festival, I mean. You've got no shifts after this, right?
We've got a little time left until the bonfire. Let's walk around together.
Are you meeting up with Katsura-san at the bonfire?
No, it's okay. Well, let's go!

File.name: 03-SB-M00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You were the one who went out shopping earlier?
Yep. My shift was already ending, so I had nothing to do.
I see. Well, I'll carry the groceries, then. Give them here.
Sheesh, Kioura was talking about it like it was a massive load. Even you could carry this much weight with no problem.
I think she did it out of consideration for me.
Because she thinks that you and I are going out.
No, it's fine. I had nothing to do anyway.
I'm all free until the bonfire.
You're meeting Katsura-san at the bonfire.
Listen... why don't we go somewhere and have some fun?
The festival. Let's see it together.
It's fine. I'll just head back to class.
You'd have nothing to do once you got back anyway.

File.name: 03-SB-M03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I just got a little annoyed.
I'm the one who should be apologizing.
Eheheh... make up and be friends.

File.name: 03-SB-M05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ooh! You can't just kiss me like that!
Eh? Just look where we are.
Oooh... I'm not talking to you.

File.name: 03-SB-M06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's okay. You don't have to force yourself.
N-no, I'll do it! Make up!
Well, I'm sure you'll start having fun once we start walking around. Let's go.

File.name: 03-SB-N00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Come on, try talking to me.
If you're free, then keep me company for a while.
My shift's finished, so once I deliver this bread and potato salad, let's take a walk around together.
Ahh... I won't force you to come if you're busy.
I-I'm not busy! Actually, I'm totally free!
Yeah, I'll bet. I can tell just by looking at you.
Sheesh. Just how long do you think we've known each other?
